title.tet: Liafuan ne'ebé Sai Ema Ida: Halo Kontente Maromak ho Haksolok iha Kristu nia Glória
title.en: The Word Became Flesh: Glorifying God by Rejoicing in the Glory of Christ

theological_insight.tet: Iha hahú foufoun, Liafuan (Logos) iha nanis ona hamutuk ho Maromak no Liafuan ne'e mak Maromak rasik. Bainhira Liafuan sai ema ida no hela iha ita-nia leet, Oan Mane Mesak hatudu sai Aman Maromak nia glória, grasa, no lia-loos ne'ebé matan ema nian labele haree. Ksolok boot liu ba ema mak halo kontente Maromak hodi haksolok iha Kristu nia glória no simu grasa tuir grasa hosi Ninia laran nakonu, hodi la'o nudar Maromak nia oan sira iha mundu nakukun laran.
theological_insight.en: In the beginning, the eternal Word (Logos) existed in divine fellowship with God and was fully God. By becoming flesh and dwelling among us, the only Son made the invisible Father known, displaying the fullness of grace and truth. Humanity's chief purpose is to glorify God by enjoying Him forever—receiving grace upon grace from Christ's fullness and living as God's redeemed, counter-cultural children in a dark world.

meditation.tet:
Iha hahú foufoun, Liafuan iha nanis ona hamutuk ho Maromak, no Liafuan ne'e mak Maromak. Nia mai nudar Naroman loloos ne'ebé nabilan iha nakukun laran, no nakukun labele halakon Nia. Iha Timor-Leste, bainhira foin-sa'e no povu sira hasoru susar iha família, kiak, laran-susar, ka tentasaun hodi fila ba ídolu no superstisaun sira, Liafuan ne'e sai ema ida no hela iha ita-nia leet. Na'i Jesus la hela dook hosi ita; Nia tama mai iha ita-nia moris ho grasa no lia-loos ne'ebé ho kbiit boot.

Ba ema hotu ne'ebé simu Nia no fiar ba Ninia naran, Nia fo kbiit atu sai Maromak nia oan sira. Ita moris mai la'ós hosi raan ka ema nia hakarak, maibé hosi Maromak rasik. Ita-nia ksolok boot liu la'ós buka iha mundu nia buat sira ne'ebé mohu lalais, maibé iha ksolok kompletu no satisfasaun rohan-laek iha Maromak. Salvasaun ne'e halo ita sai Maromak nia oan doben ne'ebé simu grasa tuir grasa hosi Ninia laran nakonu.

Rona Na'i Jesus nia lian lori dezafiu boot ba ita-nia moris loron-loron nian. Buka hatene Kristu halo ita brani atu husik tiha hahalok bosok, ídolu, no superstisaun sira. Tuir Na'i Jesus nudar eskolante ne'ebé loloos hatudu moris ne'ebé la'o iha domin, laran-moos, no dame iha família no komunidade igreja nian. Bainhira foin-sa'e sira iha Timor-Leste tahan iha susar laran ho pasiénsia no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), sira hatudu Maromak nia glória no naroman ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
In the beginning, the eternal Word who was with God and was Himself God took on human flesh and dwelt among us. Right into the realities of Timor-Leste—amid poverty, family tensions, anxiety about the future, and the lingering pull of idols and superstitious traditions—Jesus Christ, the true Light, has come. He does not remain distant in heaven; He pitched His tent right in the middle of our struggles and pain, revealing the fullness of God's grace and truth.

To all who receive Him and believe in His name, He grants the right to become children of God—born not of blood or human will, but of God Himself. Our deepest joy is never found in fleeting worldly success or empty promises, but in delighting wholeheartedly in God and drawing grace upon grace from Christ's inexhaustible fullness. This secure identity as God's beloved children gives us holy strength to overcome fear and spiritual lack.

Listening to the Savior's voice moves beyond head knowledge into bold daily obedience. Those who have tasted the glory of the Lord cast aside superstition, deceit, and dishonest habits to follow Christ wholeheartedly. Beyond personal devotion, this gospel grace bears fruit in warm reconciliation and genuine unity (laran ida) within our families and local communities. As young people and believers endure trials with patience and keep their eyes fixed on Jesus, they shine as faithful ambassadors of His light across the nation.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia laran, ó buka duni ksolok no esperansa iha Na'i Jesus Kristu, ka ó sei kaer metin ba ídulu subar, laran-rua, no ta'uk kultura nian?
reflection_questions.en: Deep in your heart, are you seeking true joy and hope solely in the Lord Jesus Christ, or are you still clinging to hidden idols, spiritual doubt, or cultural fears?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele hatudu Maromak nia grasa no lia-loos iha ó-nia família no komunidade foin-sa'e sira-nia leet ho laran-moos, domin, no uniaun (laran ida) iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you display God's grace and truth today by casting aside dishonesty and practicing love, integrity, and genuine unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak iha lalehan, ami fo agradese ba Ita-Boot nia domin boot ne'ebé haruka Ita-Boot nia Oan Mane Mesak, Liafuan ne'ebé sai ema ida hodi hela iha ami-nia leet. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha nakukun, ídulu, no ta'uk hotu-hotu, hodi kaer metin ba Na'i Jesus nia naran. Halo ami sai Ita-Boot nia oan ne'ebé simu grasa tuir grasa, no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we thank You for Your immense love in sending Your only Son, the Word made flesh, to dwell among us in grace and truth. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off all darkness, idols, superstition, and fear, trusting wholly in the name of the Lord Jesus. As Your children receiving grace upon grace from His fullness, enable us to reveal Your glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Maromak nia Bibi Oan ne'ebé Kasu Mundu nia Sala: Testemunha Laran-Haraik no Fiar Metin
title.en: The Lamb of God Who Takes Away the Sin of the World: Humble Witness and Complete Trust

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 1:19-34, João Batista haraik aan hodi nega katak nia mak Kristu, Elias, ka profeta nee, no identifika ninia aan nudar "lian ida ne'ebé hakilar iha rai fuik laran" (1:23) no atan ida ne'ebé la serve atu kore Na'i nia sandálias talin (1:27). Nia proklama Na'i Jesus nudar "Maromak nia Bibi Oan ne'ebé kasu mundu nia sala" (1:29), hodi kumpre sakrifísiu Bibi Oan Paskua nian (Ézodu 12) no Atan ne'ebé Terus (Isaías 53) liu hosi krús. Fiar loloos hetan ksolok boot liu bainhira hatún ita-nia aan atu foti sa'e Kristu nia glória de'it. La hanesan ho João ne'ebé sarani ho bee, Jesus sarani ho Espíritu Santu (1:33), hodi liberta sarani sira hosi sala no mate atu moris nudar dixípulu santu sira.
theological_insight.en: In John 1:19-34, John the Baptist humbly denies being the Christ, Elijah, or the Prophet, identifying himself solely as "the voice of one crying in the wilderness" (1:23) who is unworthy to untie the Lord's sandal strap (1:27). He proclaims Jesus as "the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world" (1:29), fulfilling both the Passover lamb (Exodus 12) and the Suffering Servant (Isaiah 53) through His cross. True faith finds its highest joy in decreasing so that Christ's glory may increase. Unlike John's water baptism, Jesus baptizes with the Holy Spirit (1:33), liberating believers from sin and idolatry to live as holy, counter-cultural disciples.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira ukun-na'in relijiozu sira husu ba João Batista, "Ó ne'e sé?", João haraik aan ho laran-moos no dehan katak nia la'ós Kristu. Nia fó sai katak nia nudar "lian ida ne'ebé hakilar iha rai fuik laran" hodi halo loos Na'i nia dalan. Nia la buka glória ba nia aan rasik, maibé foti sa'e de'it Na'i Jesus nia naran. Iha Timor-Leste, dalaruma ita tentadu atu buka foti aan, buka estatutu sosiál ka onra mundu nian. Maibé fiar ne'ebé loloos hahú hosi laran-haraik ne'ebé husik ita-nia aan atu hatudu de'it Kristu nia glória ba ema seluk.

João hakilar ho kbiit boot dehan, "Haree ba, Maromak nia Bibi Oan ne'ebé kasu mundu nia sala!" La iha serimónia tradisionál, ídulu, ka hahalok ema nian ne'ebé bele hamoos sala no hasai ta'uk iha ita-nia fuan laran. Sira hotu la bele kasu sala. Só Na'i Jesus Kristu de'it—Maromak nia Bibi Oan ne'ebé mate iha krús—mak iha kbiit kompletu atu kasu ita-nia sala no lori laran-kmaan ba ita. Bainhira foin-sa'e no povu sira iha Timor-Leste hasoru ki'ak, susar iha família, ka ta'uk ba lulik no superstisaun sira, ita tenke fila oin no fiar metin ba Bibi Oan ne'ebé fó perdaun no salvasaun loloos.

Na'i Jesus la'ós de'it kasu ita-nia sala, maibé Nia mós fó batizmu ho Espíritu Santu ba ita. Ida-ne'e hatudu katak ita la bele moris nudar sarani ne'ebé fraku ka ta'uk-teen. Ita presiza simu Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu hatudu sasin ne'ebé brani no laran-moos. Grasa ne'e tenke mosu iha ita-nia família no komunidade sarani sira-nia leet ho uniaun kompletu (laran ida), hadomi malu no moris iha lia-loos. Bainhira ita husik ita-nia aan no foti sa'e de'it Jesus nia naran, Maromak nia naroman sei nabilan iha Timor-Leste tomak.
meditation.en:
When religious leaders asked John the Baptist, "Who are you?", he unhesitatingly humbled himself, declaring that he was neither the Messiah nor a great figure, but merely "the voice in the wilderness" preparing the Lord's way. He turned all public attention away from himself and directed it solely toward Jesus Christ. In daily life in Timor-Leste, it is easy to pursue human recognition, social status, or vain pride. Yet authentic faith begins with the humility that steps aside so that Jesus Christ alone may be exalted through our lives.

Looking at Jesus, John cried out, "Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!" No human ritual, superstition, or effort can cleanse sin or remove deep-seated fear from the human heart. Only the atoning blood of Jesus Christ, the Passover Lamb provided by God the Father, completely removes the burden of our sin and darkness. When young people and believers in Timor-Leste feel bound by guilt, poverty, anxiety about the future, or cultural superstitions and idols, looking to the cross of the Lamb brings full forgiveness and true freedom.

Jesus does not merely forgive sins; He is the Son of God who baptizes us with the Holy Spirit. We must not remain passive, timid believers, but rise up in the power of the Spirit to testify boldly to the Gospel in the world. Moreover, this grace must bear fruit in our homes and church communities through warm fellowship, true unity (laran ida), and honest love. When we lay down our own boasting and lift up Jesus the Lamb alone, the holy work of the Spirit and genuine hope will fill our lives across Timor-Leste.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó buka atu foti ó-nia aan no estatutu iha ema nia oin, ka ó haraik aan hodi hatudu de'it Na'i Jesus nudar Maromak nia Bibi Oan?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, do you seek to promote your own name and status before others, or do you humble yourself like John the Baptist to exalt Jesus Christ alone as the Lamb of God?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha hahalok foti aan no lia-bosok, hodi lori dame, laran-moos, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no komunidade foin-sa'e sira ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you put aside pride and deceit today, relying on the power of the Holy Spirit to bring honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) to your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Ita-nia domin rohan-laek ne'ebé haruka Ita-nia Oan Mane, Na'i Jesus Kristu, nudar Maromak nia Bibi Oan ne'ebé kasu ami-nia sala hotu. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu moris ho laran-haraik, husik tiha hahalok foti aan, ídulu, no ta'uk superstisaun nian. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami bele hatudu sasin ne'ebé brani no moris iha uniaun (laran ida) no domin ne'ebé loloos iha ami-nia família no komunidade. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu, Bibi Oan santu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we thank You deeply for Your boundless grace in sending Your only begotten Son, Jesus Christ, as the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to humble themselves like John the Baptist, casting off all pride, idolatry, and cultural fears to exalt Jesus Christ alone. Clothe us with the power of the Lord who baptizes with the Holy Spirit, so that we may boldly testify to the Gospel through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Mai no Haree: Buka Jesus, Tuir Nia, no Haree Ninia Glória Boot
title.en: Come and See: Seeking Jesus, Following Him, and Beholding Greater Glory

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 1:35-51, André, Pedro, Filipe, no Natanael hasoru Na'i Jesus pesoalmente no hetan bolu atu sai dixípulu liu hosi konvite "Mai no haree" (1:39, 46). Bainhira Natanael rekoñese Jesus nudar Maromak nia Oan no Liurai Israél nian (1:49), Jesus hatudu katak Nia rasik mak Oan-Mane ne'ebé sai eskada ida-ne'ebé halibur lalehan ho rai (Jénezis 28). Fiar loloos la buka riku-soin mundu nian, maibé buka Kristu rasik no haksolok iha Nia. Evanjellu mós manán prekonseitu hotu (1:46), hodi halibur ema sira-ne'ebé la iha laran-makerek atu moris nudar komunidade santu Maromak nia Reinu nian.
theological_insight.en: In John 1:35-51, Andrew, Peter, Philip, and Nathanael encounter Jesus personally and are called into discipleship through His gracious invitation, "Come and see" (1:39, 46). When Nathanael confesses Him as the Son of God and King of Israel (1:49), Jesus reveals Himself as the Son of Man—the true ladder bridging heaven and earth (Genesis 28). True faith seeks Christ Himself rather than worldly gain, overflowing into joyful witness. Furthermore, the Gospel overcomes regional and social prejudice (1:46), uniting those without deceit into the holy, faithful community of God's Kingdom.

meditation.tet:
Na'i Jesus husu ba Ninia dixípulu primeiru sira, "Imi buka saida?" Pergunta ne'e mós fó naha todan ba foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste iha loron ohin. Ita buka estatutu mundu nian, riku-soin, ka seguransa falsu hosi ídulu no superstisaun sira, ka ita buka duni Na'i Jesus ho laran-moos? Bainhira dixípulu sira husu, "Ó hela iha ne'ebé?", Jesus dehan ba sira, "Mai no imi sei haree." Hela hamutuk ho Kristu mak lori ksolok ne'ebé rohan-laek no satisfasaun loloos ba ita-nia klamar.

Bainhira Filipe fó hatene ba Natanael kona-ba Jesus, Natanael dehan ho diskriminasaun no hanoin ki'ik, "Buat di'ak ida bele mai hosi Nazaré ka?" Iha sosiedade Timor-Leste nian, dalaruma ita hetan divizaun ka prekonseitu kona-ba sidade, aldeia, ka família. Maibé Filipe la haksesuk malu; nia brani atu dehan de'it, "Mai no haree!" Na'i Jesus hatene nanis Natanael nia fuan iha ai-figeira hun okos, no simu nia nudar ema loloos ne'ebé la iha lia-bosok. Kristu hatene ita-nia frakeza no moris sala hotu, maibé Nia bolu ita ho domin boot.

Ema ne'ebé hetan Jesus ho laran-moos sei lori ema seluk mai hasoru Kristu. Hanesan André lori ninia maun Pedro, no Filipe lori Natanael, desipuladu ne'ebé loloos fó benefísiu boot ba ita-nia família no komunidade hodi moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida) no laran-di'ak. Na'i Jesus promete katak ita "sei haree buat sira-ne'ebé boot liu ida-ne'e" (1:50). Bainhira ita husik tiha hahalok bosok no kaer metin ba Kristu, lalehan sei nakloke no Maromak nia glória sei leno ita-nia moris no nasaun Timor-Leste tomak.
meditation.en:
Jesus asked His first followers, "What do you seek?" That same question confronts young people and believers in Timor-Leste today. Are we seeking human recognition, wealth, social success, or the false security of idols and superstitions, or are we genuinely seeking Jesus Christ Himself? When the disciples asked where He was staying, Jesus graciously invited them, "Come and see." Abiding with Christ and dwelling in His Word brings eternal life and true joy that the world can never offer.

When Philip told Nathanael about Jesus, Nathanael revealed regional prejudice and stereotypes, asking, "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?" In Timorese society as well, hidden prejudices and divisions can arise over family lineage, regions, or social class. Yet Philip did not argue; he simply gave the bold invitation, "Come and see!" Jesus already knew Nathanael's heart beneath the fig tree and welcomed him as a true disciple without deceit. Though Christ knows all our weaknesses, past, and wounds, He still seeks us out in love.

Those who encounter Jesus personally are filled with passion to bring others to Him. Just as Andrew brought his brother Simon Peter and Philip brought Nathanael, authentic discipleship extends beyond private devotion to bear witness to Christ through love and true unity (laran ida) within our families, neighborhoods, and youth communities. Jesus promises that we "will see greater things than these" (1:50). When we turn away from worldly idols and falsehood to follow Christ wholeheartedly, heaven opens over our lives and God's abundant glory shines across Timor-Leste.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia fuan laran, ó buka duni Na'i Jesus ho laran-moos loron-loron, ka ó sei husik prekonseitu no ídulu mundu nian taka ó-nia matan?
reflection_questions.en: Deep in your heart, are you wholeheartedly seeking the Lord Jesus Christ each day, or are you allowing human prejudice and worldly idols to cloud your spiritual vision?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele dehan "Mai no haree!" hodi lori ó-nia família ka belun sira mai hasoru Na'i Jesus ho laran-moos, domin, no uniaun (laran ida) iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you say "Come and see!" today, leading your family, neighbors, or friends to Jesus Christ through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida)?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak iha lalehan, ami fó agradese ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé bolu ami ho liafuan furak "Mai no haree." Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha prekonseitu, hahalok bosok, no ídulu sira, hodi kaer metin ba Ita-nia Oan Mane. Halo ami sai dixípulu ne'ebé lori ema seluk mai hasoru Kristu ho laran-moos no uniaun (laran ida) iha ami-nia família no komunidade. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we thank You for the love of our Lord Jesus Christ, who calls us with His gracious voice, "Come and see." Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to cast aside worldly prejudice, deceit, and idols, following only Jesus, the Son of God and our King. As we walk with Him daily, empower us to boldly invite our families and neighbors to "Come and see," revealing Your glory through honesty and true unity (laran ida). We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Tua Uvas Foun no Templu Loloos: Jesus Hatudu Ninia Glória no Hamoos Ita-nia Fuan
title.en: New Wine and the True Temple: Revealing His Glory and Cleansing Our Hearts

theological_insight.tet: João 2 hatudu Na'i Jesus nia sinál primeiru iha festa kazamentu iha Kaná, hodi nakfilak bee ba tua uvas di'ak liu (2:11) atu revela Ninia glória divina no loke tempu grasa no lia-loos nian. Tua uvas foun ne'e simboliza ksolok no grasa rohan-laek iha Kristu. Iha Jerusalém, Jesus duni sai sira-ne'ebé hafoer Templu ho negósiu no kaan-teen, hodi hatudu laran-manas santu (2:17) no aponta ba Ninia isin rasik nudar Templu loloos ne'ebé sei harii fali liu hosi moris-hi'as (2:19-21). Tanba Na'i Jesus hatene ema nia fuan laran (2:24-25), Nia bolu sarani sira atu la'o iha obediénsia loloos ba Ninia liafuan (2:5) ho fuan ne'ebé moos.
theological_insight.en: John 2 presents Jesus' first public sign at the wedding in Cana, turning water into the finest wine (2:11) to reveal His divine glory and inaugurate the era of grace and truth. This abundant new wine symbolizes the unmatched joy found in Christ. In Jerusalem, Jesus cleanses the Temple from commercial greed with holy zeal (2:17), pointing to His own body as the true Temple to be raised through His resurrection (2:19-21). Because Jesus knows what is in the human heart (2:24-25), He rejects superficial faith based merely on signs, calling disciples to inner purity and wholehearted obedience to His Word (2:5).

meditation.tet:
Iha festa kazamentu iha Kaná, bainhira tua uvas hotu, ksolok mundu nian besik atu lakon ho laran-triste. Iha Timor-Leste, ita-nia moris iha família no foin-sa'e sira-nia leet dalaruma hasoru susar, ki'ak, no ksolok ne'ebé mohu lalais. Maibé Maria dehan ba atan sira, "Halo tuir buat hotu ne'ebé Nia dehan ba imi" (João 2:5). Bainhira atan sira halo tuir Na'i Jesus nia lian hodi enxe bee ba sanan fatuk sira, bee nakfilak ba tua uvas di'ak liu ne'ebé fó ksolok boot. Bainhira ita moris iha obediénsia kompletu ba Kristu nia liafuan, Nia sei muda ita-nia susar ba ksolok no grasa ne'ebé rohan-laek.

Na'i Jesus sa'e ba Templu iha Jerusalém no duni sai ema ne'ebé fa'an buat oi-oin no troka osan. Nia baku fila sira-nia meza ho laran-manas santu tanba sira halo Aman nia uma sai fatin negósiu nian. Ita-nia fuan no komunidade sarani sira mak Maromak nia Templu moris nian. Foin-sa'e no povu sira iha Timor-Leste presiza husik tiha hahalok kaan-teen, bosok, ídulu, no superstisaun sira-ne'ebé hafoer ita-nia fuan. Ita tenke husik Kristu nia laran-manas hamoos ita-nia fuan atu sai moos no santu iha Maromak nia oin.

Na'i Jesus hatene kompletu buat hotu ne'ebé iha ema nia fuan laran (João 2:24-25). Nia la fiar aan ba ema ne'ebé tuir Nia tanba de'it haree milagre iha li'ur, maibé buka fuan ne'ebé loloos no moos. Desipuladu ne'ebé loloos hatudu moris ne'ebé la'o iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha família no komunidade sarani sira-nia leet. Bainhira ita moris ho laran-moos no obediénsia ba Jesus, ita sei hatudu Ninia glória no naroman kmanek ba Timor-Leste tomak.
meditation.en:
When the wine ran out at the wedding in Cana, the joy of the celebration faced sudden ruin. In the daily lives of families and young people in Timor-Leste, earthly joy and resources likewise reach their limits, giving way to financial hardship, conflict, or emptiness. Yet Mary instructed the servants, "Whatever He says to you, do it" (John 2:5). When they obeyed Jesus and filled the stone jars with water, ordinary water became the finest wine, bringing honor and abundance to the feast. In the same way, when we walk in obedience to Christ's Word, He transforms our lack into holy joy and the richness of the Gospel.

Jesus went up to the Jerusalem Temple and drove out the merchants and money changers, overturning their tables in holy zeal because they had turned His Father's house into a marketplace of selfish gain. Indwelt by the Holy Spirit, our bodies, hearts, and church communities are God's living temple. Young people and believers in Timor-Leste must courageously clear out the deceit, greed, superstitious habits, and idols occupying the temple of their hearts, recovering Christ's holy passion (laran manas) for God's holiness.

Jesus knows every hidden thought and motive within the human heart (John 2:24-25). He does not entrust Himself to superficial faith that merely chases outward signs and wonders. Instead, the Lord seeks genuine disciples whose inner lives are cleansed and united with Him and one another in true oneness (laran ida). Relying today on His grace that washes away our stains, may we shine forth the glory of Christ in our homes and communities through honesty and holy obedience.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia fuan laran, ó husik Na'i Jesus hamoos ó-nia fuan hosi hahalok kaan-teen, bosok, no ídulu sira, ka ó sei kaer metin ba ksolok mohu mundu nian?
reflection_questions.en: Within the temple of your heart, are you allowing Jesus' Word to cleanse away worldly greed, deceit, and idols, or are you still clinging to the fading comforts of this world?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele halo tuir Na'i Jesus nia liafuan ("Halo tuir buat hotu ne'ebé Nia dehan") hodi lori laran-moos, servisu haraik aan, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no komunidade iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you practice the command, "Whatever He says to you, do it," today by bringing honesty, humble service, and true unity (laran ida) into your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak iha lalehan, ami fó agradese ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé hatudu Ninia glória hodi halo bee nakfilak ba tua uvas foun, no hamoos Templu ho laran-manas. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha hahalok bosok, kaan-teen, no ídulu sira. Hakonu ami ho laran-moos atu ami halo tuir buat hotu ne'ebé Na'i Jesus dehan, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida) no santidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who revealed His glory by turning water into new wine and cleansed the Temple with holy zeal. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to cast out worldly greed, deceit, and idols, renewing us as Your holy temple. Grant us grace to obey whatever He commands, brightly reflecting Christ's glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Moris Foun hosi Espíritu Santu no Fiar ba Oan Mane: Maromak nia Domin Boot ba Mundu
title.en: New Life from the Holy Spirit and Faith in the Son: God's Great Love for the World

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 3, Na'i Jesus hateten ba Nicodemos katak ema la bele tama iha Maromak nia Reinu liu hosi hahalok di'ak ka relijiaun de'it, maibé tenke moris fali hosi bee no Espíritu Santu (3:3-5). Kristu hiit sa'e iha krús atu lori salvasaun ba ema hotu ne'ebé fiar ba Nia (3:14-16). Ksolok loloos mosu bainhira sarani sira hatún sira-nia aan atu Kristu de'it mak sai boot liu (3:30), hodi husik tiha nakukun sala nian no la'o iha naroman lia-loos nian (3:19-21).
theological_insight.en: In John 3, Jesus teaches Nicodemus that human morality or religious knowledge cannot bring anyone into God's Kingdom; one must be born again of water and the Spirit (3:3-5). Just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, the Son of Man is lifted up on the cross so that whoever believes in Him receives eternal life through the Father's sacrificial love (3:14-16). True joy flourishes when believers decrease so Christ may increase (3:30), stepping out of darkness into the light of truth to live in holy, Spirit-empowered freedom (3:19-21).

meditation.tet:
Nicodemos mai hasoru Na'i Jesus iha kalan ho matenek no estatutu aas, maibé ninia klamar sei hamrook ba Maromak nia reinu. Jesus hanorin nia ho klaru katak ema ne'ebé la moris fali la bele haree Maromak nia reinu (João 3:3). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira la bele depende de'it ba abitu kultura nian ka moris iha li'ur de'it. Ita-nia moris tuan, ta'uk ba lulik aat, no ídulu sira presiza husik tiha. Ita tenke moris fali hosi bee no hosi Espíritu Santu hodi simu moris foun ne'ebé ho kbiit boot.

Maromak hadomi tebes mundu, to'o Nia fó Ninia Oan Mane mesak, atu ema hotu ne'ebé fiar ba Nia sei la lakon, maibé sei hetan moris rohan-laek (João 3:16). Promesa kmanek ne'e fó esperansa rohan-laek ba foin-sa'e sira ne'ebé hasoru ki'ak, susar, no laran-susar iha moris loron-loron nian. Na'i Jesus ne'ebé hiit sa'e iha krús mak Salvadór mesak ne'ebé lori ita sai hosi nakukun. Ema ne'ebé halo buat ne'ebé loos sei mai iha naroman, hodi hatudu katak sira-nia hahalok la'o iha Maromak nia laran-moos.

João Batista hatudu laran-haraik ne'ebé kmanek hodi dehan katak Kristu tenke sai boot liu, no nia rasik tenke sai ki'ik liu (João 3:30). Desipuladu ne'ebé loloos la'ós buka foti aan ka buka onra mundu nian, maibé foti sa'e de'it Na'i Jesus nia naran. Bainhira ita husik tiha egoízmu no hahalok bosok sira, hodi moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida) no domin iha ita-nia família no komunidade sarani sira, Espíritu Santu nia kbiit no Maromak nia glória sei leno naroman ba Timor-Leste tomak.
meditation.en:
Nicodemus came to Jesus by night possessing scholarly wisdom and high religious status, yet his soul still hungered for God's Kingdom. Jesus clearly explained that unless one is born again, he cannot see the Kingdom of God (John 3:3). Young people and believers in Timor-Leste likewise cannot rely on outward religious observance or cultural customs alone for eternal life. Our old nature, along with reliance on superstitions and idols, must be set aside so that we may be completely reborn through water and the Holy Spirit.

God loved the world so deeply that He gave His only begotten Son, so that everyone who believes in Him will not perish but have everlasting life (John 3:16). This glorious Gospel declaration brings enduring hope to Timorese youth navigating poverty, hardship, and uncertainty about the future. Lifted up on the cross, Jesus Christ is the sole Savior who rescues us from darkness. While those who cling to evil avoid the light, those who practice the truth come boldly into the light so that their obedience in God may be clearly seen.

John the Baptist humbly confessed that Christ must increase while he himself must decrease (John 3:30). Genuine discipleship does not pursue personal prestige, boasting, or worldly acclaim; rather, it delights in seeing the name of Jesus Christ honored through our lives. When we lay aside pride and selfishness to love one another and live in complete unity (laran ida) within our families and youth communities, God's Kingdom and holy glory will shine brightly across Timor-Leste.

reflection_questions.tet: Ó sa'e ona ba naroman hosi moris foun iha Espíritu Santu, ka ó sei subar iha nakukun hodi kaer metin ba ídulu no hahalok tuan sira?
reflection_questions.en: Have you stepped into the light through new birth in the Holy Spirit, or are you still hiding in the darkness by holding onto old worldly habits and superstitions?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele hatudu hahalok haraik aan atu Kristu sai boot liu iha ó-nia moris, hodi lori laran-moos, servisu haraik aan, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no komunidade iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you practice the spirit of decreasing so that Christ may increase today, bringing honesty, humble service, and true unity (laran ida) into your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese ba Ita-nia domin boot ne'ebé fó Ita-nia Oan Mane mesak, Na'i Jesus Kristu, atu lori moris rohan-laek mai ami. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu moris fali hosi Espíritu Santu, husik tiha nakukun, ídulu, no hahalok bosok sira. Hakonu ami atu moris ho laran-haraik, hodi foti sa'e de'it Na'i Jesus nia naran, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida) no santidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we thank You for Your great love in sending Your only begotten Son, Jesus Christ, to grant us eternal life through new birth in the Holy Spirit. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off our old nature, darkness, idols, and deceit, stepping boldly into Your light. Like John the Baptist, grant us humility to decrease so that Jesus Christ alone is exalted, revealing Your Kingdom's glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Bee Moris Nian no Adorasaun iha Espíritu no Lia-Loos: Na'i Jesus Kura Klamar ne'ebé Hamrook
title.en: The Living Water and Worship in Spirit and Truth: Jesus Christ Heals the Thirsty Soul

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 4:1-26, Na'i Jesus liu hosi Samaria hodi hasoru feto ida iha Jacó nia bee-posu no promete "bee moris nian" ne'ebé halakon hamrook ba nafatin (4:14). Nia hatene feto ne'e nia sala subar hotu, sobu divizaun etnia no relijiaun nian, no hanorin katak Aman buka ema sira-ne'ebé adora Nia iha espíritu no iha lia-loos (4:23-24). Bainhira Jesus dehan, "Ha'u mak Nia" (4:26), Nia revela aan nudar Mesias loloos ne'ebé fó satisfasaun rohan-laek ba klamar.
theological_insight.en: In John 4:1-26, Jesus passes through Samaria to meet a woman at Jacob's well, offering "living water" that quenches spiritual thirst forever (4:14). Exposing her hidden sin while breaking down ethnic and religious barriers, Jesus teaches that true worship is not bound to Jerusalem or Mount Gerizim, but is rendered to the Father "in spirit and truth" (4:23-24). Declaring "I am He" (4:26), Christ reveals Himself as the promised Messiah who alone satisfies the human soul eternally and transforms sinners into true worshipers.

meditation.tet:
Na'i Jesus tuur iha Jacó nia bee-posu iha meiudia ho kolen viajen nian, hodi hein feto Samaria ida ne'ebé hamrook iha nia klamar. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma moris iha hamrook no susar laran tanba buka ksolok iha buat mundu nian ka superstisaun sira. Maibé buat sira-ne'e hotu halo ita hamrook fali. Na'i Jesus dehan ho grasa boot, "Ema ne'ebé hemu hosi bee ne'ebé Ha'u sei fó ba nia sei nunka hamrook" (João 4:14). Só Kristu de'it mak bee moris nian ne'ebé fó ksolok kompletu no satisfasaun rohan-laek ba ita-nia moris.

Na'i Jesus hatene kompletu feto ne'e nia moris sala no sala subar sira. Bainhira Jesus dehan, "Bá bolu ó-nia la'en", feto ne'e presiza rekoñese ho laran-moos. Na'i Jesus hatene ita-nia frakeza, sala subar, no kanek sira hotu, maibé Nia la mai atu kondena ita, maibé atu kura no lori salvasaun mai ita. Bainhira ita husik tiha hahalok bosok no konfesa ita-nia sala iha naroman laran, ita simu perdaun no dame ne'ebé kmanek.

Bainhira feto ne'e husu kona-ba fatin adorasaun nian, Na'i Jesus dehan, "Maromak mak Espíritu, no sira-ne'ebé adora Nia tenke adora iha espíritu no iha lia-loos" (João 4:24). Adorasaun loloos la'ós depende ba fatin ka serimónia iha li'ur de'it, maibé moris iha Espíritu Santu nia kbiit no iha Maromak nia lia-loos loron-loron. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha família no komunidade, Na'i Jesus ne'ebé mak Mesias loloos sei suli sai bee moris nian iha sira-nia moris no nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
Even when weary from His journey in the midday heat, Jesus sat by Jacob's well in Sychar waiting to meet a Samaritan woman. In daily life across Timor-Leste, many young people and believers wander through spiritual thirst, emptiness, and anxiety about the future. Earthly wealth, pleasures, or the false comfort of idols and superstitions quench thirst only momentarily before leaving the soul dry again. Yet Jesus declares, "Whoever drinks of the water that I shall give him will never thirst" (John 4:14). Only the living water Christ gives can satisfy the deepest longing of our souls.

Jesus knew every detail of the woman's hidden past and pain. Before His command, "Go, call your husband," she had to face her life honestly without pretense. The Lord knows all our past wounds, secret failings, and moral sins, yet He seeks us out not to condemn us, but to heal and make us new. When we honestly confess our hidden sins and shame in His light, true peace and liberation begin.

When the woman asked about the proper place of worship, Jesus answered, "God is Spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth" (John 4:24). Authentic worship is not confined to a building or outward ritual; it is a life of encountering God honestly in His truth through the power of the Holy Spirit. When Timorese youth cast aside deceit and superstition to worship God in honesty, love, and complete unity (laran ida) within their homes and church communities, Christ becomes an ever-flowing spring of living water in their lives.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris, ó buka duni bee moris nian hosi Na'i Jesus Kristu atu hakonu ó-nia klamar, ka ó sei hemu hosi bee mundu nian ne'ebé halo ó hamrook fali?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, is your soul drinking solely from the eternal living water that Jesus Christ gives, or are you still chasing worldly wells that leave you thirsty again?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele adora Maromak iha espíritu no iha lia-loos hodi lori laran-moos, husik tiha lia-bosok, no harii uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no komunidade iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you worship God in spirit and truth today by casting aside deceit and practicing honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar Mesias no fó bee moris nian ne'ebé lori ksolok rohan-laek. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha bee mundu nian, ídulu, no sala subar sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami bele adora Ita-Boot iha espíritu no iha lia-loos, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida) no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You deep thanks for the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, who came to us as the Messiah and the source of living water that quenches our thirst forever. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to turn away from the empty wells of this world and hidden sins, finding true satisfaction in the living water Christ provides. Empower us to worship You daily in spirit and truth, revealing the holiness of Your Kingdom through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: To'os ne'ebé Prontu atu Silu no Fiar iha Na'i Jesus nia Liafuan: Evanjelizasaun no Salvasaun ba Uma-Kain
title.en: The Harvest Ready to Reap and Faith in Jesus' Word: Evangelism and Household Salvation

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 4:27-54, sasin feto Samaria nian lori ema barak mai fiar ba Kristu nudar "mundu nia Salvadór" (4:42), no Jesus hanorin katak Ninia ai-han loloos mak atu halo tuir Aman nia hakarak no kumpre Ninia servisu (4:34). Iha Kaná, ema boot ida fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus nia liafuan de'it hodi la haree uluk sinál ho matan: "Bá de'it, ó-nia oan sei moris" (4:50). Fiar ne'ebé husik tiha sanan-rai moe nian no kaer metin ba lia-loos lori ksolok boot no salvasaun ba ema ida-idak no ba uma-kain tomak.
theological_insight.en: In John 4:27-54, the Samaritan woman's testimony leads many to confess Christ as "the Savior of the world" (4:42), while Jesus teaches that His true nourishment is doing the Father's will and finishing His work (4:34). In Cana, a royal official trusts Jesus' spoken word—"Go your way; your son lives"—without first demanding a visible sign (4:50). Leaving behind the waterpots of worldly shame to rely purely on Christ's Word brings lasting soul-satisfaction and extends salvation to entire households.

meditation.tet:
Feto Samaria ne'ebé ho laran-moos hetan Na'i Jesus, nia husik hela ninia sanan-rai no halai ba sidade laran hodi hakilar, "Mai lai! Haree mane ida-ne'ebé fó hatene mai ha'u kona-ba buat hotu ne'ebé ha'u halo ona. Nia mak Kristu karik?" (João 4:29). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma lori sanan-rai moe nian, hahalok bosok, ka ta'uk ba lulik aat sira. Maibé bainhira ita simu Kristu nia grasa, ita brani husik tiha sanan-rai mundu nian no sai sasin ne'ebé brani ho laran-moos atu lori ema seluk mai hasoru Salvadór.

Bainhira dixípulu sira fó ai-han ba Jesus, Nia dehan, "Ha'u-nia ai-han mak atu halo tuir Ninia hakarak ne'ebé haruka Ha'u mai, no atu halo Ninia servisu to'o kompletu" (João 4:34). Ita-nia klamar nia ksolok loloos la'ós mai hosi riku-soin ka ksolok mohu mundu nian, maibé hosi obediénsia kompletu ba Maromak nia hakarak. To'os sira prontu ona atu silu. Iha Timor-Leste, iha família no foin-sa'e sira-nia leet, ema barak hein hela evanjelizasaun no grasa Maromak nian. Ita presiza foti oin no serví Maromak ho laran-manas.

Ema boot hosi Kafarnaum mai hasoru Jesus tanba ninia oan-mane moras besik atu mate. Bainhira Jesus dehan ba nia, "Bá de'it, ó-nia oan sei moris" (João 4:50), ema boot ne'e fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus nia liafuan no la'o fila ba uma ho konfiansa. Nia la presiza haree sinál ho matan mós nia fiar kedas Jesus nia lian. Rezultadu mak ninia oan isin di'ak fali no ninia uma-kain tomak fiar ba Jesus. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste la fila ba ídulu ka superstisaun sira iha susar laran, maibé fiar metin ba Jesus nia liafuan ho uniaun kompletu (laran ida), Maromak sei lori salvasaun boot no kura ba ita-nia uma-kain no nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
After encountering Jesus, the Samaritan woman immediately left behind her waterpot—the symbol of her past shame and spiritual thirst—and ran into town, calling out, "Come, see a Man who told me all things that I ever did. Could this be the Christ?" (John 4:29). As the townspeople came to hear His Word, they confessed Him as "the Savior of the world." Many believers and young people in Timor-Leste carry heavy waterpots of past wounds, guilt, or worldly attachments. Yet those touched by Christ's grace leave those burdens behind and stand boldly as witnesses to the Gospel.

When the disciples urged Him to eat, Jesus replied, "My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me, and to finish His work" (John 4:34). True fullness of soul does not come from material wealth or temporary comfort, but from obeying God's will and joining His spiritual harvest. Just as the fields were already white for harvest, countless souls across families, villages, and youth communities in Timor-Leste await the grace of God. Setting aside earthly anxieties, we are called to feast on the spiritual nourishment of serving our Lord.

A royal official from Capernaum came to Jesus in desperation as his son lay near death. When Jesus declared, "Go your way; your son lives" (John 4:50), the father believed Jesus' word without seeing any immediate sign and began his journey home. Just as spoken, the boy's fever vanished, leading the official and his entire household to believe. When we reject superstitions and idols amid sickness or financial crisis and trust wholly in Christ's promises, God brings true unity (laran ida) and household salvation into our homes and communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris, ó lori naha todan ho sanan-rai moe nian no buka ksolok mundu nian, ka ó husik tiha buat sira-ne'e hodi han Maromak nia ai-han ne'ebé halo Ninia hakarak?
reflection_questions.en: In your life today, are you still carrying waterpots of past shame and worldly attachment, or have you laid them down to feed on doing God's will as a bold witness to Christ?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus nia liafuan iha susar no moras laran, hodi lori laran-moos, fiar, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia uma-kain tomak iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you put aside superstition and rely solely on Jesus' Word during times of crisis or illness, fostering honesty, faith, and true unity (laran ida) within your entire household today?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar mundu nia Salvadór, ne'ebé halo ami-nia klamar bosu ho Maromak nia hakarak. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha sanan-rai moe nian, hahalok bosok, no ídulu sira. Hakonu ami atu fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus nia liafuan ho laran-moos, no lori salvasaun, dame, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ami-nia uma-kain tomak no komunidade. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Savior of the world, who satisfies our souls as we do Your will. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to lay down their waterpots of shame and worldly distraction, rejecting all superstition and idols to stand boldly as witnesses to Your Gospel. Grant us unwavering trust in Your Word through every trial, bringing household salvation, honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Hamriik, Foti Ó-nia Biti, no La'o: Kbiit Kura nian no Glória Oan Mane nian
title.en: Rise, Take Up Your Bed, and Walk: Healing Power and the Divine Glory of the Son

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 5:1-23, Na'i Jesus kura mane ida-ne'ebé moras durante tinan 38 iha Betesda nia kolan liu hosi liafuan ida de'it (5:8), hodi hatudu grasa soberana ba ema ne'ebé la iha kbiit atu salva aan rasik. Bainhira ukun-na'in sira kondena kura iha loron Sábadu, Jesus deklara, "Ha'u-nia Aman servisu nafatin to'o agora, no Ha'u mós servisu nafatin" (5:17), hodi hatudu Ninia divindade hanesan ho Aman Maromak. Oan-Mane iha autoridade divina atu fó moris ba ema mate no tesi lia (5:21-22), hodi halakon legalizmu relijiozu no fó deskansa salvasaun nian.
theological_insight.en: In John 5:1-23, Jesus heals a man who had been invalid for thirty-eight years at the pool of Bethesda by His sovereign word alone (5:8), demonstrating unconditional grace to the utterly helpless. When religious leaders condemn the healing on the Sabbath, Jesus declares, "My Father has been working until now, and I have been working" (5:17), affirming His full equality and unity with God the Father. Possessing divine authority to give life to the dead and execute judgment (5:21-22), the Son shatters oppressive legalism and grants true Sabbath rest.

meditation.tet:
Iha Betesda nia kolan, iha mane ida-ne'ebé moras to'o tinan tolu-nulu resin ualu ona. Nia la iha kbiit atu hatama aan ba kolan laran, no la iha ema ida atu ajuda nia. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma sente kbiit-laek, ki'ak, moras, ka susar iha família ne'ebé kleur ona no la bele halai sai hosi susar ne'e. Maibé Na'i Jesus mai hasoru nia ho grasa boot no dehan, "Hamriik ba. Foti ó-nia biti, no la'o ba!" (João 5:8). Bainhira Jesus ko'alia, kbiit kura nian tama kedas iha ninia isin, no fatin esperansa-laek sai fatin salvasaun nian.

Bainhira mane ne'e sai di'ak no lori ninia biti, ukun-na'in sira kritika nia tanba loron ne'e mak Sábadu. Sira hanoin liu tradisaun no lei iha li'ur de'it duké ksolok ema ida-ne'ebé sai di'ak fali. Dalaruma ita mós hela iha ábitu sarani nian iha li'ur ka superstisaun sira-ne'ebé halo ita-nia fuan toos. Maibé Na'i Jesus dehan, "Ha'u-nia Aman servisu nafatin to'o agora, no Ha'u mós servisu nafatin" (João 5:17). Kristu sobu tiha hahalok tradisaun toos sira no fó deskansa no liberdade loloos ba ita-nia klamar.

Na'i Jesus mak Maromak nia Oan ne'ebé iha kbiit boot hamutuk ho Aman Maromak. Nia foti ema mate hodi fó moris ba sira, no Nia iha kbiit atu tesi lia ba ema hotu (João 5:21-22). Bainhira ita fó onra ba Oan-Mane, ita fó onra ba Aman Maromak. Ohin loron, ita tenke brani atu hamriik hosi fatin kbiit-laek no la'o ho fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus nia lian. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste husik tiha hahalok bosok no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade, Maromak nia kbiit kura nian sei nabilan iha ita-nia uma-kain no komunidade tomak.
meditation.en:
By the pool of Bethesda lay a helpless man bound by illness for thirty-eight years, unable even to enter the water on his own. Echoing his lament, "I have no man to put me into the pool," many young people and believers in Timor-Leste feel trapped by prolonged poverty, sickness, family wounds, and powerlessness they cannot escape alone. Yet Jesus came to him unconditionally and commanded, "Rise, take up your bed and walk!" (John 5:8). The moment Christ spoke His creative word, a place of thirty-eight years of despair became a place of healing and salvation.

When the healed man carried his mat, the Jewish religious leaders condemned him for breaking their Sabbath rules. They valued outward religious traditions and legalistic frameworks more than the joy of a restored soul. Believers today can likewise lose the power of true life when trapped in outward religious habits, superstitious customs, or routine observance. Yet Jesus declared, "My Father has been working until now, and I have been working" (John 5:17), shattering the yoke of legalism to grant us true spiritual rest and freedom.

Jesus is the eternal Son of God, completely one with the Father, holding divine authority to raise the dead and judge all people (John 5:21-23). To honor the Son is to honor the Father. Today, let us rise from every place of helplessness where our own strength has failed, trusting fully in the powerful Word of the Lord. As we walk away from sin and past sorrow in bold faith, God's saving grace will flourish through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and youth communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris, ó sei toba iha fatin kbiit-laek no esperansa-laek nian, ka ó rona ona Na'i Jesus nia lian hodi hamriik, foti ó-nia biti, no la'o ho fiar?
reflection_questions.en: Are you still lying down in a place of powerlessness and despair, or have you heard Jesus' powerful command to rise, take up your bed, and walk forward in faith?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha hahalok krítika no legalizmu toos sira, hodi lori kbiit kura nian, laran-moos, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you put aside judgmental religious formalism and legalism today to bring Christ's healing grace, honesty, and true unity (laran ida) to your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar Maromak nia Oan ne'ebé iha kbiit boot atu kura no fó moris foun ba ami. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu hamriik hosi fatin kbiit-laek, ki'ak, no ta'uk nian. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami la'o ho fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus nia liafuan, no lori kura, dame, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who came to us in our helplessness with sovereign grace to heal and raise the dead. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to rise from prolonged powerlessness, poverty, and despair, walking boldly in the truth of Your Word. Free us from outward formalism and superstition so that we honor the Son above all, reflecting Your Kingdom's glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Rona Na'i Jesus nia Lian no Fiar: Moris Rohan-Laek no Testemunha Eskritura nian
title.en: Hearing Jesus' Voice and Believing: Eternal Life and the Witness of Scripture

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 5:24-47, Na'i Jesus deklara katak Nia mak hun moris nian no iha kbiit atu tesi lia ba ema hotu. Ema ne'ebé rona Ninia liafuan no fiar ba Aman ne'ebé haruka Nia muda ona hosi mate ba moris rohan-laek (5:24). Jesus aprezenta sasin haat hodi prova Ninia divindade: João Batista (5:33-35), Ninia milagre no servisu sira (5:36), Aman Maromak rasik (5:37-38), no Eskritura sira inklui Moisés nia hakerek (5:39, 45-47). Fiar loloos la buka glória hosi ema seluk (5:44), maibé buka glória ne'ebé mai hosi Maromak mesak hodi hakbesik ba Kristu ne'ebé Eskritura sira fó sasin.
theological_insight.en: In John 5:24-47, Jesus declares that He is the source of life and holds sovereign authority over resurrection and final judgment, assuring that whoever hears His word and believes in the Father has passed from death into eternal life (5:24). He presents four compelling witnesses to His deity: John the Baptist (5:33-35), His works and miracles (5:36), God the Father Himself (5:37-38), and the Old Testament Scriptures including Moses' writings (5:39, 45-47). True faith rejects seeking human praise (5:44) and pursues the glory that comes from God alone by coming personally to Christ, the true subject of all Scripture.

meditation.tet:
Na'i Jesus fó sai ho kbiit boot dehan, "Ema ne'ebé rona Ha'u-nia liafuan, no fiar Ida ne'ebé haruka Ha'u mai, nia hetan moris rohan-laek. Nia sei la hetan kastigu. Nia muda hosi mate ba moris" (João 5:24). Iha Timor-Leste, bainhira foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira hasoru ki'ak, moras, ka ta'uk ba lulik aat no futuru sira, promesa kmanek ne'e fó seguransa rohan-laek ba ita-nia klamar. Salvasaun la'ós de'it esperansa ba aban-bairua, maibé kbiit moris nian ne'ebé hahú ohin loron bainhira ita rona no fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus nia lian.

Ema Judeu sira buka hatene Eskritura sira, maibé sira lakohi mai iha Jesus atu hetan moris rohan-laek (João 5:39-40). Sira la iha Maromak nia domin iha sira-nia laran, tanba sira buka glória hosi ema seluk duké buka glória ne'ebé mai hosi Maromak mesak de'it (João 5:42, 44). Iha Timor-Leste, ita la bele moris ho ábitu sarani iha li'ur de'it ka buka onra mundu nian hosi sosiedade. Eskritura hotu-hotu fó sasin kona-ba Na'i Jesus Kristu. Ita tenke liu ábitu toos sira no mai hasoru Jesus ne'ebé moris hodi simu grasa no kbiit loloos.

Fiar ne'ebé loloos husik tiha foti aan no buka glória mundu nian. Bainhira ita buka de'it Maromak nia glória, ita bele moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ita-nia família no komunidade foin-sa'e sira-nia leet. Hanesan Moisés no Eskritura sira hakerek kona-ba Jesus, ita-nia moris loron-loron nian presiza sai sasin ne'ebé nabilan kona-ba Na'i Jesus nia naran. Bainhira ita rona no halo tuir Ninia liafuan, Maromak nia glória no dame sei leno naroman ba Timor-Leste tomak.
meditation.en:
Jesus solemnly declares, "Most assuredly, I say to you, he who hears My word and believes in Him who sent Me has everlasting life, and shall not come into judgment, but has passed from death into life" (John 5:24). When believers and young people in Timor-Leste face poverty, illness, fear of the future, or spiritual anxiety, this promise serves as an unshakable anchor of salvation. Salvation is not merely a distant hope; it is a present reality that begins the moment we hear and obey Christ's voice, transferring our souls from death and darkness into eternal life.

The religious leaders of Jesus' day diligently studied the Scriptures, yet refused to come to Jesus Himself to receive life (John 5:39-40). They lacked the love of God within them because they sought praise from one another rather than the glory that comes from the only God (John 5:42, 44). In our own walk of faith, we must avoid resting in outward religious routines or mere head knowledge while secretly chasing human approval, status, or superstitious comfort. Every page of Scripture bears witness that Jesus of Nazareth is the Son of God and sole Savior, calling us to encounter Him personally in His Word each day.

Genuine faith lays aside human applause to seek God's glory alone. Pursuing recognition from others inevitably breeds envy and division, whereas fixing our eyes on God and listening to Christ's voice empowers us to abandon pride and deceit. Within our families and youth communities, this humility bears fruit in true unity (laran ida) and sacrificial love. Just as Moses and all the Scriptures point to Jesus, may our entire lives become faithful channels bearing witness to Christ alone.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó buka duni glória ne'ebé mai hosi Maromak mesak de'it, ka ó sei buka glória no onra hosi ema seluk no mundu nian?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you seeking the glory that comes from God alone, or are you still chasing human praise, status, and worldly recognition?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele rona Na'i Jesus nia liafuan iha Eskritura hodi lori laran-moos, husik tiha foti aan, no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you listen closely to Jesus' voice in Scripture today, setting aside pride and boasting to bring honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) to your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé lori moris rohan-laek mai ami no fó sasin kona-ba Ita-nia lia-loos. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha foti aan, buka glória mundu nian, no ídulu sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami rona no halo tuir Na'i Jesus nia liafuan iha Eskritura, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for granting eternal life and transfer from death to life to all who hear the Word of Jesus Christ and believe in You. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to lay aside human applause, worldly status, and idols, seeking the glory that comes from God alone. Draw us humbly each day to Jesus, the true Lord of Scripture, so that we may hear His voice and reflect Your Kingdom's glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Paun hosi Lalehan no Kbiit ne'ebé Taka Tasi Boot: Na'i Jesus nudar Paun Moris nian no Na'i ba Kbiit Hotu
title.en: Bread from Heaven and Power Over the Raging Sea: Jesus Christ as the Bread of Life and Lord of All

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 6:1-21, Na'i Jesus hatudu Ninia soberania divina liu hosi milagre rua: fó han ba ema rihun lima ho paun fuan lima no ikan rua (6:1-14) no la'o iha tasi leten ne'ebé anin-fuik boot. Hodi fó paun iha rai-fuik laran, Jesus revela aan nudar Paun moris nian ne'ebé tun hosi lalehan no fó moris ba ema ne'ebé hamlaha. Bainhira ema lubun hakarak obriga Nia sai liurai mundu nian, Jesus lakohi no sa'e ba foho atu halo orasaun (6:15). Iha laloran boot laran, Nia hakbesik ba dixípulu sira hodi dehan, "Ne'e mak Ha'u. Keta ta'uk!" (6:20), hodi hatudu Ninia kbiit nudar Kriadór no Salvadór ne'ebé lori dame ba Ninia povu.
theological_insight.en: In John 6:1-21, Jesus displays His divine sovereignty through two sequential miracles: feeding five thousand people with five loaves and two fish (6:1-14) and walking upon a stormy sea. By providing bread in the wilderness, Jesus reveals Himself as the true Bread of Life come down from heaven who abundantly satisfies human need. Rejecting the crowd's attempt to make Him a worldly king, He withdraws to pray (6:15), and amid raging waves declares to His disciples, "It is I; do not be afraid" (6:20), revealing His divine identity as Creator and Savior who brings His people safely to shore.

meditation.tet:
Iha rai-fuik laran, Na'i Jesus haree ema lubun boot ne'ebé hamlaha ho laran-sadia. Bainhira labarik-mane ida fó ninia paun sevada fuan lima no ikan ki'ik rua, Jesus foti no fó agradese ba Maromak, no fahe ba ema hotu to'o sira bosu no hela bote sanulu resin rua nakonu. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma sente kbiit-laek ho ki'ak, kbiit-laek iha kapasidade ka susar iha finanseiru. Maibé bainhira ita entrega buat ki'ik ne'ebé ita iha ba Na'i Jesus nia liman ho laran-moos, Nia sei fakar sai bensaun no grasa ne'ebé riku liu ba ita-nia família no komunidade tomak.

Povu sira haree milagre ne'e no hakarak kaer Jesus atu obriga Nia sai sira-nia liurai mundu nian (João 6:15). Maibé Jesus husik sira no sa'e ba foho mes-mesak atu halo orasaun. Na'i Jesus la'ós mai atu fó de'it paun isin nian ka ksolok mohu mundu nian, maibé Nia mak Paun moris nian ne'ebé fó salvasaun rohan-laek ba ita-nia klamar. Foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste presiza husik tiha fiar sala sira, kaer metin ba Kristu nia evanjellu, no la'ós buka de'it riku-soin mundu nian, maibé buka Maromak nia reinu no Ninia hahalok loos.

Bainhira kalan ne'ebé nakukun tama no anin huu maka'as iha tasi leten, dixípulu sira sente ta'uk tebes. Maibé Na'i Jesus la'o iha tasi leten no hakbesik ba sira ho lian kmanek dehan, "Ne'e mak Ha'u. Keta ta'uk!" (João 6:20). Bainhira sira simu Jesus tama ba ró laran ho haksolok, ró ne'e to'o kedas iha fatin ne'ebé sira atu bá. Bainhira ita-nia moris, família, ka foin-sa'e sira hasoru susar boot no ta'uk iha moris loron-loron nian, ita tenke simu Na'i Jesus iha ita-nia fuan laran. Bainhira Kristu hela iha ita-nia leet ho uniaun kompletu (laran ida), Nia sei lori dame, seguransa, no salvasaun loloos ba Timor-Leste tomak.
meditation.en:
Seeing the hungry multitude in the wilderness, Jesus was moved with compassion. When a young boy offered his five small barley loaves and two fish, Jesus gave thanks and distributed them until everyone ate their fill with twelve baskets left over. Across Timor-Leste, many young people and believers feel anxious or powerless in the face of poverty, financial hardship, or limited resources. Yet when we humbly place even the smallest gifts into Jesus' hands, He multiplies them to pour out abundant grace and Gospel blessing upon our families and villages.

Witnessing the miracle, the crowd tried to take Jesus by force to make Him an earthly, political king (John 6:15). Rejecting their worldly ambitions, Jesus withdrew alone to the mountain to pray. Christ did not come merely to provide physical bread or temporary worldly success; He is the eternal Bread of Life who rescues our souls from sin and death. Young people and believers in Timor-Leste must turn away from worldly prosperity-seeking or superstitious comfort, choosing instead to follow Jesus Christ wholeheartedly as our true life.

When darkness fell and a fierce storm tossed the disciples' boat on the sea, fear and despair gripped their hearts. Yet Jesus walked across the waves and spoke words of sovereign peace: "It is I; do not be afraid" (John 6:20). As soon as they willingly received Him into the boat, they immediately reached the safe shore. Whenever storms of crisis or trial strike our homes and youth communities, rather than turning to idols or human schemes, let us welcome Jesus, the Lord of all creation, into the center of our hearts so His peace, honesty, and true unity (laran ida) may prevail.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris, ó buka duni Na'i Jesus nudar Paun moris nian ba ó-nia klamar, ka ó sei buka de'it paun isin nian no ksolok mohu mundu nian?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily walk, are you relying on Jesus Christ as the eternal Bread of Life for your soul, or are you still chasing temporary worldly pleasures and material satisfaction?

reflection_questions.tet: Bainhira ó hasoru anin maka'as no tasi boot iha moris loron-loron nian, oinsá mak ó bele simu Na'i Jesus iha ó-nia fuan hodi lori laran-moos, dame, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: When fierce storms and trials arise in your life today, how can you cast aside fear, welcome Jesus into your heart, and foster honesty, peace, and true unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar Paun moris nian no Na'i ba kbiit hotu ne'ebé hakmatek anin maka'as iha tasi leten. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha ta'uk, foti aan, no ídulu mundu nian. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami simu Na'i Jesus iha ami-nia moris laran, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), dame, no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, who satisfies our souls as the Bread of Life and walks across the raging sea to bring us peace. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to cast aside vain desires and idols, longing wholeheartedly for Jesus alone, the Bread come down from heaven. Amid every storm and trial, grant us grace to hear His voice, "It is I; do not be afraid," welcoming Him into our lives to glorify Your name through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Paun Moris nian ne'ebé Tun hosi Lalehan: Fiar iha Kristu no Moris Rohan-Laek
title.en: The Bread of Life Come Down from Heaven: Faith in Christ and Eternal Life

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 6:22-40, Na'i Jesus korrije ema lubun ne'ebé buka Nia tanba de'it paun isin nian, hodi bolu sira atu servisu ba ai-han ne'ebé dura to'o moris rohan-laek (6:27). Servisu Maromak nian la'ós esforsu relijiozu ema nian, maibé fiar metin ba Ida ne'ebé Aman haruka mai (6:29). Hanesan Paun moris nian ne'ebé tun hosi lalehan (6:35), Kristu hakonu klamar ba nafatin no garante katak ema hotu ne'ebé hakbesik ba Nia sei la lakon, maibé sei moris hi'as fali iha loron ikus (6:37-40).
theological_insight.en: In John 6:22-40, Jesus redirects the crowd from chasing temporary physical bread toward laboring for enduring spiritual nourishment (6:27). Rather than demanding human religious achievement, He defines the true work of God as trusting in the One sent by the Father (6:29). As the true Bread of Life come down from heaven (6:35), Christ satisfies the soul's deepest hunger forever and guarantees that none who come to Him will ever be cast out, promising resurrection on the last day (6:37-40).

meditation.tet:
Bainhira povu sira ne'ebé han paun bosu iha rai-fuik laran buka Na'i Jesus to'o Kafarnaum, Jesus fó hatene sira-nia motivu laran nian: sira buka Nia tanba sira han paun to'o bosu, la'ós tanba komprende sinál divina. Tanba ne'e, Nia hanorin sira atu keta servisu de'it ba ai-han ne'ebé lakon mohu, maibé servisu atu hetan ai-han ne'ebé dura to'o moris rohan-laek (João 6:26-27). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma buka fiar tanba de'it buka riku-soin mundu nian, ksolok mohu, ka buka hakmatek iha ábitu no superstisaun sira. Maibé buat sira-ne'e hotu mak ai-han ne'ebé lakon mohu, ne'ebé la bele lori salvasaun ba ita-nia klamar.

Bainhira povu husu saida mak sira tenke halo atu hala'o Maromak nia servisu, Na'i Jesus hatán ho lia-loos katak Maromak nia servisu mak atu fiar ba Ida ne'ebé Nia haruka mai (João 6:29). Maromak nia servisu la'ós naha todan ho hahalok ema nian, maibé fiar metin no simu Na'i Jesus Kristu iha ita-nia fuan. Maná iha rai-fuik fó han de'it isin temporáriu, maibé Na'i Jesus mak Paun moris nian ne'ebé tun hosi lalehan. Ema ne'ebé mai iha Jesus sei la hamlaha tan, no ema ne'ebé fiar ba Nia sei la hamrook tan iha klamar laran.

Na'i Jesus fó promesa boot katak ema hotu ne'ebé Aman fó mai Nia sei mai iha Nia, no sira-ne'ebé mai iha Nia, Nia sei la duni sai (João 6:37). Maromak nia hakarak mak fó moris rohan-laek ba ema hotu ne'ebé fiar ba Oan-Mane, no halo sira moris hi'as fali iha loron ikus. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste husik tiha ta'uk, hahalok bosok, no buka ksolok mohu nian, hodi mai hasoru Na'i Jesus nudar Paun moris nian, Kristu sei fakar sai ksolok loloos no dame iha ita-nia fuan. Ita tenke moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ita-nia família no komunidade tomak.
meditation.en:
Having experienced the multiplication of loaves and fish, the crowds crossed the sea to Capernaum looking for Jesus out of a desire for physical fullness and material gain. Discerning their motives, Jesus urged them not to labor for food that perishes, but for the food that endures to eternal life (John 6:26-27). In everyday life across Timor-Leste, young people and believers can easily treat faith merely as a means to overcome immediate poverty, secure earthly success, or find superstitious comfort. Yet perishable provisions only satisfy briefly and can never save our souls.

When the crowd asked what works they needed to perform to do the works of God, Jesus answered clearly that God's work is to believe in the One whom He sent (John 6:29). True obedience does not begin with accumulating religious merits or human achievements, but with placing wholehearted trust in God's only begotten Son. Unlike the wilderness manna that sustained ancestors only temporarily, Jesus is the true Bread come down from heaven; whoever comes to Him in faith will never hunger or thirst spiritually again.

Jesus further assures us that everyone the Father gives Him will come to Him, and the one who comes to Him He will by no means cast out (John 6:37). It is the Father's will that all who look to the Son and believe receive eternal life and be raised up on the last day. When Timorese youth and believers lay aside anxiety, superstition, and past wounds to come humbly to Christ, He welcomes us with lasting peace and salvation. Leaving behind perishable pursuits today, may we be filled with the Bread of Life and live victoriously in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our homes and communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó buka duni Paun moris nian iha Na'i Jesus Kristu ba ó-nia klamar, ka ó sei lakon tempu servisu ba ai-han ne'ebé lakon mohu no riku-soin mundu nian?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you truly longing for Jesus Christ as the Bread of Life for your soul, or are you spending your energy chasing perishable worldly comforts and status?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele hatudu fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus nudar Maromak nia servisu, hodi lori laran-moos, husik tiha hahalok bosok, no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: Remembering that believing in the One God sent is the true work of God, how can you set aside self-righteousness today to foster honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar Paun moris nian ne'ebé tun hosi lalehan hodi fó moris rohan-laek ba ami-nia klamar. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha ai-han ne'ebé lakon mohu, ídulu, no hahalok bosok sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for sending Jesus Christ, the true Bread of Life come down from heaven, so that we may have eternal life. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to turn away from perishable pursuits, worldly distractions, and idols, trusting wholeheartedly in Christ alone. Relying on Your promise never to cast out those who come to You, grant us grace to walk closely with Jesus each day and reflect Your holy glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Paun Moris nian no Liafuan Moris Rohan-Laek nian: Fiar Metin ba Kristu no Hela iha Nia
title.en: The Bread of Life and the Words of Eternal Life: Steadfast Faith and Abiding in Christ

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 6:41-71, Na'i Jesus hateten iha sinagoga iha Kafarnaum katak ema ne'ebé han Ninia isin no hemu Ninia raan hela iha Nia no hetan moris rohan-laek (6:54-56), hodi hatudu sakrifísiu krús nian no uniaun espirituál ho Kristu. Espíritu mak fó moris, la'ós isin (6:63). Bainhira dixípulu barak fila kotuk tanba liafuan ne'e todan ba sira (6:60, 66), Simão Pedro konfesa ho fiar metin, "Na'i, ami atu bá ho sé loos? Ó mak iha liafuan moris rohan-laek nian" (6:68), hodi hili Kristu nudar hun moris nian.
theological_insight.en: In John 6:41-71, Jesus concludes His Capernaum synagogue discourse by declaring that whoever eats His flesh and drinks His blood abides in Him and has eternal life (6:54-56), pointing to His atoning death on the cross and vital spiritual union with believers. Because the flesh profits nothing and it is the Spirit who gives life (6:63), many superficial followers turn away when confronted with the cost of discipleship (6:60, 66). In contrast, Peter confesses, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life" (6:68), anchoring true faith in Christ alone.

meditation.tet:
Iha sinagoga iha Kafarnaum, bainhira Na'i Jesus dehan, "Ema ne'ebé han Ha'u-nia isin, no hemu Ha'u-nia raan, nia mak hela iha Ha'u, no Ha'u hela iha nia" (João 6:56), ema barak rona ho laran-toos no murmuura dehan, "Liafuan ne'e todan. Sé mak bele rona?" (João 6:60). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma haksolok tuir Jesus bainhira simu bensaun isin nian, maibé bainhira evanjellu husu atu husik tiha ídulu, superstisaun, ka hahalok bosok sira, sira sente naha todan no hakarak fila fali ba mundu. Maibé Jesus fó hatene ho naroman, "Espíritu mak fó moris; isin la folin buat ida" (João 6:63).

Bainhira dixípulu barak fila kotuk no lakohi la'o tan ho Jesus, Na'i Jesus husu ba sira na'in sanulu resin rua ho lian maus, "Imi mós hakarak bá ka?" Simão Pedro hatán ho fiar metin no laran-moos, "Na'i, ami atu bá ho sé loos? Ó mak iha liafuan moris rohan-laek nian. Ami fiar no hatene duni katak Ó mak Ida Ne'ebé Santu hosi Maromak" (João 6:68-69). Bainhira ema barak husik Kristu tanba buka ksolok mohu mundu nian, Pedro hili atu hela hamutuk ho Jesus tanba Nia mak hun moris rohan-laek nian.

Ohin loron, Na'i Jesus husu mós ba foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste, "Imi mós hakarak bá ka?" Ita hakarak fila ba nakukun, superstisaun, no hahalok bosok sira, ka ita hakarak kaer metin ba Na'i Jesus ne'ebé fó moris rohan-laek ba ita-nia klamar? Bainhira ita simu Na'i Jesus nia isin no raan nudar sakrifísiu iha krús no hela iha Nia, ita simu kbiit atu moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ita-nia família no komunidade. Bainhira ita kaer metin ba Kristu nia liafuan, Maromak nia glória sei nabilan iha Timor-Leste tomak.
meditation.en:
When Jesus declared in the synagogue at Capernaum, "Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life... He abides in Me, and I in him" (John 6:54-56), His listeners were deeply shaken. Failing to grasp this solemn spiritual truth, they grumbled, "This is a hard saying; who can understand it?" (John 6:60). In daily life across Timor-Leste, it is tempting to follow Jesus gladly when faith brings earthly blessing and comfort, yet pull back when the Gospel demands bearing the cross, living honestly, and breaking completely with superstitions and idols. Still, the flesh profits nothing; only the Spirit gives life.

As many disciples turned back and walked with Him no more, Jesus quietly asked the Twelve, "Do you also want to go away?" (John 6:67). Without hesitation, Simon Peter answered, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life. Also we have come to believe and know that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God" (John 6:68-69). While crowds walked away in search of earthly convenience, Peter chose Jesus Christ Himself as the source of eternal life.

Today, that same question confronts young people and believers in Timor-Leste: "Do you also want to go away?" Amid worldly desires, poverty, hardship, or the pressure of superstitious traditions, will we turn back to the world, or remain steadfastly with Christ? As we feed by faith upon His body and blood offered on the cross and abide in Him, we receive eternal life and stand together as true disciples in honesty, love, and complete unity (laran ida) within our families and youth communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Bainhira moris lori susar no naha todan, ó hakarak fila kotuk no husik Na'i Jesus, ka ó dehan ho fiar metin nudar Pedro, "Na'i, ami atu bá ho sé loos? Ó mak iha liafuan moris rohan-laek nian"?
reflection_questions.en: When faced with life's trials or the demanding call of Christ's Word, are you tempted to turn back to the world, or do you confess with Peter, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life"?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele hela iha Na'i Jesus nia liafuan hodi lori laran-moos, husik tiha hahalok bosok, no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: Guided by the truth that the Spirit gives life while the flesh profits nothing, how can you set aside human boasting today to practice honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé fó Ninia isin no raan nudar sakrifísiu iha krús, no fó liafuan moris rohan-laek nian ba ami. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu la fila kotuk no la husik Na'i Jesus iha susar laran. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami hela metin iha Kristu, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, who gave His body and shed His blood on the cross to grant us eternal life. Strengthen the young people and believers in Timor-Leste so that they never turn away in the face of temptation or hardship, but confess daily, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life." By the power of the Holy Spirit, help us abide in Christ and follow the way of the cross faithfully through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and youth communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Mota Bee Moris nian no Doutrina hosi Maromak: Fiar ba Na'i Jesus no Simu Espíritu Santu
title.en: Rivers of Living Water and Teaching from God: Believing in Jesus and Receiving the Holy Spirit

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 7, Na'i Jesus hanorin iha Templu durante Festa Baraka nian, hodi la buka glória mundu nian maibé halo tuir de'it Aman Maromak nia tempu no hakarak (7:6, 16-17). Iha loron ikus festa nian, Jesus hakilar hodi konvida ema hotu ne'ebé hamrook atu mai hemu iha Nia, hodi promete katak ema ne'ebé fiar ba Nia sei simu Espíritu Santu nudar mota bee moris nian ne'ebé suli sai hosi ninia laran (7:37-39). Evanjellu sobu prekonseitu relijiozu no fó aten-brani ba sarani sira atu la'o iha lia-loos.
theological_insight.en: In John 7, Jesus teaches in the Temple during the Feast of Tabernacles, rejecting worldly fame to obey the Father's timing and will (7:6, 16-17). On the final great day of the feast, He invites all who thirst to come to Him and drink, promising that rivers of living water—referring to the Holy Spirit—will flow from the hearts of those who believe in Him (7:37-39). The Gospel dismantles religious prejudice and empowers disciples to stand courageously in the truth.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira Festa Baraka besik ona, Na'i Jesus nia alin sira dehan ba Nia atu hatudu aan ba mundu hodi sai ema koñesidu. Maibé Jesus hatán ho laran-moos dehan katak Ninia tempu seidauk to'o (João 7:6). Jesus la buka glória mundu nian ka rona ema nia lian ne'ebé ho laran-kaan, maibé obedese de'it ba Aman Maromak nia tempu no hakarak. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma sente presaun hosi sosiedade, família, ka tradisaun sira atu buka estatutu ka tuir ábitu sala sira. Maibé dixípulu loloos la'ós buka glória ba ninia aan rasik, maibé hein Maromak nia tempu no la'o iha laran-haraik.

Iha Templu laran, Na'i Jesus hanorin katak Ninia doutrina la'ós Ninia rasik, maibé mai hosi Aman ne'ebé haruka Nia mai (João 7:16). Ema ne'ebé buka de'it Maromak nia glória la iha hahalok bosok iha ninia laran.
