Bainhira guarda sira bá atu kaer Jesus, sira la kaer Nia tanba sira hakfodak ho Ninia liafuan ne'ebé nakonu ho autoridade divina (João 7:46). Iha mundu ne'ebé nakonu ho lian aat, lia-bosok, no divizaun sira, ita tenke rona no kaer metin ba Na'i Jesus nia lia-loos ne'ebé lori kbiit no salvasaun loloos.

Iha loron ikus iha festa ne'e, Na'i Jesus hamriik no konvida ema hotu ne'ebé hamrook atu mai iha Nia no hemu, hodi promete katak mota bee moris nian sei suli sai hosi sira-nia laran (João 7:37-38). Liafuan kmanek ne'e ko'alia kona-ba Espíritu Santu ne'ebé sira-ne'ebé fiar ba Kristu sei simu. Ksolok mundu nian lori hamrook fali, maibé Espíritu Santu ne'ebé Jesus fó fakar sai mota bee moris nian iha ita-nia klamar laran. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste husik tiha divisaun, prekonseitu, no ídulu sira, hodi moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos, Espíritu Santu nia mota bee moris nian sei suli sai no lori kmaan no naroman ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
As the Feast of Tabernacles approached, Jesus' brothers urged Him to display Himself publicly to gain worldly acclaim. Yet Jesus remained unmoved by human impatience or applause, choosing instead to walk in humble obedience to the Father's timing and will (John 7:6). Young people and believers in Timor-Leste often face similar pressures from society, peers, or family traditions to chase recognition or conform to superstitious customs. True discipleship, however, turns away from self-promotion to wait patiently on God's timing in humble obedience.

Standing in the Temple courts, Jesus declared that His teaching came not from Himself, but from the Father who sent Him (John 7:16). Those who seek their own glory harbor deceit, whereas those seeking God's glory walk in truth and spiritual power. Even the Temple guards sent to arrest Jesus returned empty-handed, overwhelmed by the unmatched authority of His words (John 7:46). Amid the competing voices and false teachings of this world, we must listen intently to the life-giving truth of Jesus Christ.

On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and called out to every thirsty soul to come to Him and drink, promising that rivers of living water would flow from within those who believe (John 7:37-38). This promise points directly to the Holy Spirit poured out upon believers. While worldly comforts inevitably leave us thirsty again, the Spirit whom Christ gives becomes an unfailing spring of living water within our hearts. As Timorese youth and believers lay aside prejudice, division, and idols to walk in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida), streams of living water will overflow across our homes and communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris, ó buka glória no estatutu hosi ema no mundu nian, ka ó hein ho pasiénsia Maromak nia tempu no hemu hosi mota bee moris nian iha Espíritu Santu?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you chasing human approval and worldly recognition, or are you patiently waiting on God's timing and drinking from the living water of the Holy Spirit?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha divizaun, prekonseitu, no hahalok bosok sira, hodi lori laran-moos no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you set aside prejudice, division, and deceit today to foster honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé fó doutrina lia-loos nian no fó promesa kmanek kona-ba Espíritu Santu nudar mota bee moris nian. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha foti aan, divizaun, no ídulu mundu nian. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami mai no hemu hosi Na'i Jesus, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, who teaches us the truth from God and pours out the Holy Spirit as rivers of living water within our souls. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to lay aside impatience for worldly acclaim and humbly obey Your timing and will. Free us from prejudice, falsehood, and idols so that we come daily to Jesus to drink of His grace, reflecting Your glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and youth communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Naroman Mundu nian no Grasa ne'ebé Kura: Husik Tiha Nakukun no Moru iha Kristu
title.en: The Light of the World and Healing Grace: Leaving Darkness to Walk in Christ

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 8:1-30, ukun-na'in relijiozu sira lori feto ida ne'ebé kaer iha hahalok adultériu hodi koko Na'i Jesus, maibé Jesus dehan ba sira atu ema ne'ebé sala la iha mak tuda uluk fatuk (8:7). Nia la kondena feto ne'e maibé fó perdaun no haruka nia atu keta halo sala tan (8:11). Depois, Jesus revela aan nudar Naroman Mundu nian ne'ebé duni sai nakukun sala nian (8:12) no afirma katak Nia mak Ida ne'ebé Aman haruka mai no sei hiit sa'e iha krús atu lori salvasaun (8:24, 28).
theological_insight.en: In John 8:1-30, religious leaders bring a woman caught in adultery to trap Jesus, yet He disarms their self-righteousness by inviting whoever is without sin to cast the first stone (8:7). Upholding holiness while extending grace, Jesus refuses to condemn her and calls her to leave her life of sin (8:11). He then proclaims Himself the Light of the World who rescues souls from darkness (8:12) and affirms His divine identity as the One to be lifted up on the cross for humanity's salvation (8:24, 28).

meditation.tet:
Bainhira ukun-na'in sira lori feto ida ne'ebé halo sala adultériu no hakarak tuda mate nia ho fatuk, Na'i Jesus hakruuk no hakerek iha rai, depois hamriik no dehan katak ema ne'ebé sala la iha mak bele tuda uluk fatuk (João 8:7). Iha liafuan kmanek ne'e nia oin, ema hotu husik tiha fatuk no sai hosi fatin ne'e, hahú hosi katuas sira. Iha Timor-Leste, iha ita-nia família no komunidade leet, dalaruma ita ho laran-toos tesi lia no julga ema seluk nia frakeza, hahalok sala, ka moris ki'ak. Maibé iha Kristu nia oin, ita hotu presiza Maromak nia laran-luak. Na'i Jesus fó perdaun ba feto ne'e ho domin boot no haruka nia atu la'o no keta halo sala tan (João 8:11). Na'i Jesus la mai atu kondena ita, maibé atu fó perdaun no fakar sai grasa foun ba ita-nia klamar.

Na'i Jesus hanorin iha Templu laran katak Nia mak naroman mundu nian, no ema ne'ebé tuir Nia sei la la'o iha nakukun laran, maibé sei hetan naroman moris nian (João 8:12). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma moris iha nakukun laran tanba ta'uk ba superstisaun sira, hahalok bosok, lia-aat, ka buka ksolok mohu mundu nian. Maibé buat sira-ne'e hotu lori ita ba nakukun no mate. Só Na'i Jesus de'it mak naroman loloos ne'ebé duni sai nakukun no fó naroman moris nian ba ita-nia fuan.

Ita presiza husik tiha fiar toos no ta'uk ba ema nia oin, hodi fó fuan tomak ba Na'i Jesus ne'ebé hiit sa'e iha krús tanba ita. Komunidade sarani ne'ebé simu Kristu nia perdaun la tesi lia aat ba maluk sira, maibé moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), laran-moos, no laran-luak ba malu. Ohin loron, mai ita husik tiha fatuk julgamentu nian iha ita-nia liman, hodi la'o ho ksolok no brani iha Na'i Jesus nia naroman kmanek, no lori dame no naroman ba Timor-Leste tomak.
meditation.en:
When religious leaders brought a woman caught in adultery to Jesus, ready to stone her in anger and condemnation, He stooped down to write on the ground before calling the sinless among them to throw the first stone (John 8:7). Confronted by His divine wisdom, everyone dropped their stones and walked away, beginning with the oldest. Within our families and communities in Timor-Leste, it is all too easy to point fingers at others' failings, past mistakes, poverty, or weaknesses. Yet before Christ, we all stand as sinners in need of mercy. Gently pardoning the woman, Jesus called her to go and sin no more (John 8:11), showing that He came not to condemn us, but to forgive us through the cross and call us into a holy new life.

Standing in the Temple courts, Jesus proclaimed Himself the Light of the World, promising that whoever follows Him will never walk in darkness but will have the light of life (John 8:12). Many young people and believers still struggle in the shadows of superstitious traditions, impurity, deceit, gambling, violence, or anxiety about the future. No cultural custom or earthly comfort can drive away spiritual darkness; only welcoming Jesus Christ as Savior fills our hearts with true peace and life-giving light.

Setting aside lukewarm formalism and the fear of human opinion, we are called to wholehearted devotion to the Savior lifted up on the cross for us. A community shaped by Christ's unconditional forgiveness lays down stones of judgment to embrace one another in honesty, grace, and true unity (laran ida). Relying today on the mercy that pardoned us, may we walk courageously as holy disciples in the light of Christ.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris, ó kaer metin fatuk julgamentu nian hodi tesi lia aat ba maluk sira-nia frakeza, ka ó rona Na'i Jesus nia lian ne'ebé fó perdaun no bolu ó atu moris santu?
reflection_questions.en: Are you holding onto stones of judgment to criticize others' faults, or are you receiving Jesus' forgiving grace and extending that same mercy to those around you?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha nakukun hahalok bosok nian no superstisaun sira, hodi la'o iha Na'i Jesus nia naroman no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you turn away from darkness, deceit, and superstitious habits today, walking in Christ's light to bring honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) to your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar naroman mundu nian, ne'ebé la kondena ami maibé perdoa ami-nia sala ho grasa boot iha krús. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha fatuk tesi lia nian, nakukun bosok nian, no ídulu sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami la'o iha Na'i Jesus nia naroman, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the love of our Lord Jesus Christ, who forgave us through the grace of the cross instead of condemning us, coming into the world as our true Light. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to lay down stones of judgment and cast off darkness, impurity, deceit, and superstition. Empower us to walk faithfully in the light of Christ alone, shining forth Your Kingdom's holiness through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Lia-Loos ne'ebé Halo Livre no Kristu ne'ebé Moris Hori Uluk Kedas: Husik Tiha Atan Sala nian no Hela iha Na'i Jesus nia Liafuan
title.en: The Truth That Sets Free and Christ Who Exists from Eternity: Leaving Slavery to Sin to Abide in Jesus' Word

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 8:31-59, Na'i Jesus hanorin katak ema ne'ebé hela iha Ninia liafuan sei hatene lia-loos no sai livre loloos (8:31-32). Ema hotu ne'ebé halo sala mak atan ba sala, no só Oan-Mane de'it mak bele halo sira livre hosi koren sala nian (8:34, 36). Hodi rejeita foti aan hosi jerasaun ka relijiaun de'it, Jesus deklara Ninia divindade rohan-laek: "Molok Abraão moris, Ha'u iha ona" (8:58), hodi hatudu katak Nia mak Kriadór no Salvadór ne'ebé lori ksolok no liberdade ba Ninia povu.
theological_insight.en: In John 8:31-59, Jesus teaches that abiding in His Word leads to knowing the truth and experiencing genuine freedom (8:31-32). Because everyone who practices sin is enslaved to sin, only the Son can break those chains and grant true spiritual liberty (8:34, 36). Dismantling pride rooted in ancestry or outward religious status, Jesus proclaims His eternal deity—"Before Abraham was, I AM" (8:58)—revealing Himself as the Creator and Redeemer in whom believers find lasting joy and adoption as God's children.

meditation.tet:
Na'i Jesus hateten ba ema ne'ebé fiar ba Nia katak se sira hela metin iha Ninia liafuan, sira mak Ninia dixípulu duni, sei koñese lia-loos, no lia-loos sei halo sira livre (João 8:31-32). Ema Judeu sira foti aan tanba sira mak Abraão nia bei-oan no hanoin sira nunka sai atan ba ema ida. Maibé Jesus esplika ho klaru katak ema ne'ebé halo sala mak atan ba sala (João 8:34). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma foti aan ho estatutu família nian ka ábitu sarani iha li'ur de'it, maibé moris loron-loron nian sei kesi metin iha sala nakukun nian, ta'uk ba superstisaun sira, lia-bosok, ka hemu tua demais. Ábitu li'ur nian la bele lori salvasaun loloos ba ita-nia klamar.

Na'i Jesus fó promesa kmanek katak se Oan-Mane mak halo ita livre, ita sei sai livre duni (João 8:36). Diabu ne'ebé mak lia-bosok nia aman hakarak lohi ita atu moris iha hahalok aat no ta'uk laran. Maibé Na'i Jesus Kristu, ne'ebé fakar Ninia raan iha krús, harahun tiha atan nia koren ho Ninia grasa boot. Liberdade loloos la'ós moris tuir hakarak aat mundu nian, maibé moris livre hosi sala hodi obedese ba Maromak nia hakarak ho ksolok boot.

Na'i Jesus fó sai Ninia glória eterna hodi deklara katak molok Abraão moris, Nia iha ona (João 8:58). Nia mak Maromak ne'ebé moris hori uluk kedas. Ema Judeu sira foti fatuk atu tuda Nia tanba sira-nia fuan toos, maibé ita presiza hakneak iha Kristu nia oin. Ita presiza husik tiha foti aan mundu nian, superstisaun, no hahalok bosok sira. Bainhira ita simu Na'i Jesus nia perdaun no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ita-nia família no komunidade, lia-loos sei halo ita livre loloos no lori Maromak nia naroman ba Timor-Leste tomak.
meditation.en:
Jesus told those who believed in Him that abiding in His Word marks true discipleship, leading to knowledge of the truth that sets us free (John 8:31-32). Relying on their ancestry as Abraham's descendants, His listeners boasted that they had never been slaves to anyone. Yet Jesus pointed out solemnly that whoever commits sin is a slave of sin (John 8:34). In daily life across Timor-Leste, young people and believers can easily take comfort in family heritage or outward religious routines while remaining bound in everyday life by impurity, deceit, gambling, alcohol abuse, or superstitious fears. Outward religious identity can never rescue a soul from sin.

Christ declares with grace that if the Son makes us free, we shall be free indeed (John 8:36). The devil, the father of lies, seeks to keep hearts trapped in worldly desires, secret sins, and fear. Through His blood shed on the cross, Jesus shattered the chains of our bondage. True Christian freedom is not a license to indulge selfish desires, but the holy liberty to break free from sin and joyfully obey God's will.

Proclaiming His eternal existence before Abraham was born (John 8:58), Jesus revealed Himself as the everlasting Creator. While hardened hearts picked up stones against Him, we are called to lay aside worldly pride and stubborn self-reliance to bow humbly before Christ. Freed from slavery to sin and adopted into God's family, believers renounce falsehood and superstition to walk in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within their homes and youth communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó sei kesi metin nudar atan ba sala, superstisaun, ka hahalok bosok sira, ka ó hela iha Na'i Jesus nia liafuan hodi simu liberdade loloos?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you still living in bondage to secret sinful habits, superstition, or deceit, or are you abiding in Jesus' Word to experience His true freedom?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha foti aan estatutu nian no lia-bosok sira, hodi lori laran-moos, perdaun, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you let go of outward pride and falsehood today, practicing honesty, forgiveness, and true unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé moris hori uluk kedas no fó libertasaun loloos ba ami-nia klamar hosi atan sala nian. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha foti aan estatutu nian, superstisaun, no hahalok bosok sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami hela metin iha Na'i Jesus nia liafuan, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who exists eternally before Abraham and rescued us from slavery to sin through the grace of the cross. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste not to rest in outward religious pride or family background, but to cast off hidden sinful habits, falsehood, and superstition. Empower us by Your Spirit to abide daily in Your Word of truth and reveal Your Kingdom's glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Ema Matan Delek ne'ebé Hetan Naroman no Fiar iha Maromak nia Oan: Hela iha Naroman no Husik Tiha Matan Delek Espíritu nian
title.en: The Light of the World Who Opened the Blind Man's Eyes: Leaving Spiritual Blindness to Worship Christ

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 9, Na'i Jesus kura ema ida ne'ebé moris mai matan delek iha loron Sábadu atu revela Maromak nia hahalok no hatudu katak Nia mak Naroman Mundu nian (9:3, 5). Maski ukun-na'in Farizeu sira ameasa no duni sai mane ne'e hosi sinagoga, nia fó sasin ho brani kona-ba lia-loos no hakneak hodi adora Maromak nia Oan (9:25, 35-38). Matan delek espirituál mak trajédia boot liu duké moras isin nian, no evanjellu sobu foti aan relijiozu sira-ne'ebé hanoin sira haree maibé hela iha sala laran (9:41).
theological_insight.en: In John 9, Jesus heals a man born blind on the Sabbath to display God's works and prove Himself to be the Light of the World (9:3, 5). Despite intense interrogation and expulsion from the synagogue by religious authorities, the healed man boldly testifies to the truth and falls down to worship the Son of Man (9:25, 35-38). Spiritual blindness is far more tragic than physical disability, and the Gospel dismantles the religious pride of those who claim to see while remaining trapped in sin (9:41), calling believers to joyful, courageous worship.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira dixípulu sira haree ema matan delek ne'ebé moris mai nune'e nanis, sira husu sé mak halo sala to'o nia moris matan delek: nia rasik ka ninia inan-aman. Maibé Na'i Jesus hatán ho grasa boot katak ida-ne'e la'ós tanba mane ne'e ka ninia inan-aman halo sala, maibé atu Maromak nia hahalok bele hatudu liu hosi nia (João 9:3). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma tesi lia no ko'alia aat maluk sira-nia moris ki'ak, moras, ka susar iha família ho hanoin superstisaun nian. Maibé Kristu mai la'ós atu tesi lia aat, maibé atu hatudu Maromak nia kbiit kura nian no salva ita-nia klamar.

Ema ne'ebé haree fali ne'e hasoru presaun boot hosi ukun-na'in Farizeu sira ne'ebé ameasa atu duni sai nia hosi sinagoga. Maibé nia ho brani fó sasin katak uluk nia matan delek no agora nia haree (João 9:25). Bainhira ema duni sai tiha nia, Na'i Jesus bá buka nia no husu se nia fiar ba Maromak nia Oan. Mane ne'e hakneak iha Kristu nia oin no konfesa ho laran-moos katak nia fiar, hodi adora Nia (João 9:38). Fiar loloos la'ós ta'uk ba ema nia oin ka sosiedade nia julgamentu, maibé adora Na'i Jesus Kristu ho brani nudar ita-nia Salvadór.

Ema Farizeu sira hanoin sira haree no hatene buat hotu, maibé tuir loloos sira mak matan delek iha klamar laran tanba foti aan no la fiar ba Jesus (João 9:41). Ita presiza husik tiha foti aan, hahalok bosok, jogu aat, sala fo'er, no superstisaun sira-ne'ebé halo ita-nia klamar matan delek. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste matan nakloke hosi Espíritu Santu no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Na'i Jesus nia naroman kmanek sei fakar sai ksolok no salvasaun loloos ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
Seeing a beggar blind from birth, the disciples viewed his suffering through a lens of condemnation, asking whether his own sin or his parents' sin had caused his condition. Jesus gently corrected them, explaining that his blindness existed so that the works of God might be revealed in him (John 9:3). In everyday life across Timor-Leste, believers and young people sometimes judge neighbors' poverty, sickness, or family struggles as the result of ancestral sins or superstitions. Yet Christ transforms human suffering not into an occasion for blame, but into a channel of grace that displays God's healing power and saving glory.

Once healed, the man refused to bow before the relentless intimidation of the religious leaders or the threat of expulsion from the synagogue. Even under pressure, he stood firm on the simple truth that though he had been blind, now he could see (John 9:25). True discipleship refuses to be silenced by human disapproval or social loss, bearing fearless witness to Christ. When Jesus sought out the rejected man, he fell in worship and confessed his faith (John 9:38), modeling how believers must bow before Jesus alone amid worldly opposition.

The Pharisees prided themselves on knowing the Scriptures and seeing clearly, yet remained spiritually blind to Jesus, the Light of the World (John 9:41). Genuine godliness rests not on intellectual pride or outward status, but on humbly admitting our spiritual blindness and coming to Christ for sight. As young people and believers in Timor-Leste cast aside gambling, impurity, deceit, and superstition to walk in Christ's light, honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) will flourish throughout our homes and youth communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó foti aan nudar ema ne'ebé haree no tesi lia aat ba maluk sira, ka ó admite ho laran-haraik katak ó presiza Na'i Jesus atu loke ó-nia klamar matan?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, do you proudly assume you see clearly while judging others, or do you humbly admit your spiritual blindness and ask Jesus, the Light of the World, to open your eyes?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha matan delek hahalok bosok nian, hahalok aat, no superstisaun sira, hodi la'o iha naroman no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you turn away from the spiritual blindness of deceit, destructive habits, and superstition today, walking in Christ's light to bring honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) to your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar naroman mundu nian, ne'ebé loke ema matan delek nia matan no fó salvasaun ba ami-nia klamar. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha matan delek foti aan nian, tesi lia aat, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami haree Ita-nia glória, adora Na'i Jesus ho laran-moos, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who came as the Light of the World to open the eyes of the blind and heal our spiritual blindness. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off pride, judgment toward others, and superstition. Open our eyes daily by Your grace so that we may bow in humble worship before Christ, reflecting Your Kingdom's glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and youth communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Bibi Atan Di'ak no Odamatan Salvasaun nian: Rona Na'i Jesus nia Lian no Hetan Moris Nakonuk
title.en: The Good Shepherd and the Door of Salvation: Hearing Jesus' Voice and Finding Abundant Life

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 10:1-21, Na'i Jesus revela aan nudar Odamatan ba bibi sira (10:7, 9) no Bibi Atan Di'ak ne'ebé koñese Ninia bibi sira-nia naran ida-idak no fó Ninia moris iha krús tanba sira (10:3-4, 11, 14-15). La hanesan ho na'ok-teen ne'ebé mai atu na'ok no estraga ka atan ne'ebé halai bainhira asu-fuik mai, Jesus mai atu fó moris ne'ebé nakonu resin (10:10). Nia mós halibur bibi seluk atu sai luhan ida de'it ho bibi-atan ida de'it (10:16), hodi hatudu Ninia kbiit divina atu entrega no foti fali Ninia moris (10:18).
theological_insight.en: In John 10:1-21, Jesus reveals Himself as both the Door of the sheep (10:7, 9) and the Good Shepherd who knows His sheep by name and lays down His life for them voluntarily on the cross (10:3-4, 11, 14-15). Unlike thieves who come to steal and destroy or hired hands who abandon the flock in danger, Christ comes to give abundant, overflowing life (10:10). Gathering other sheep into one flock under one Shepherd (10:16), He displays sovereign power to lay down His life and take it up again (10:18), dismantling selfish leadership and grounding believers in eternal satisfaction.

meditation.tet:
Na'i Jesus ko'alia ho laran-moos dehan, "Ha'u mak odamatan... Na'ok-teen mai de'it atu na'ok, oho no estraga. Ha'u mai hodi sira bele hetan moris, no hetan moris to'o nakonu resin" (João 10:9-10). Na'ok-teen no ema ne'ebé simu osan hodi hein de'it bibi la hanoin bibi sira-nia moris. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma rona lian oin-foun sira hosi mundu, superstisaun sira, hemu tua demais, hahalok bosok, ka buka de'it riku-soin mundu nian ne'ebé na'ok ksolok no estraga klamar. Maibé buat sira-ne'e hotu mak na'ok-teen ne'ebé na'ok ksolok loloos. Na'i Jesus de'it mak Odamatan salvasaun nian ne'ebé fó moris nakonuk ba ita-nia klamar.

Na'i Jesus fó sai Ninia domin kmanek dehan, "Ha'u mak Bibi Atan di'ak. Bibi Atan di'ak fó ninia moris tanba bibi" (João 10:11). Ema ne'ebé servisu-na'in de'it halai bainhira asu-fuik mai tanba nia la hanoin bibi. Maibé Na'i Jesus koñese ita-nia naran ida-idak, la'o iha ita-nia oin, no fó Ninia moris iha krús tanba ita. Bibi sira la'o tuir Bibi Atan tanba sira hatene Ninia lian, no sira sei halai hosi ema oin-foun sira.

Ita presiza husik tiha fiar toos, hahalok bosok, no lian aat mundu nian, hodi rona no la'o tuir Na'i Jesus nia lian de'it. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste rona Bibi Atan Di'ak nia lian no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Maromak nia bensaun no moris nakonuk sei fakar sai ksolok no dame ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
Jesus plainly declares, "The thief does not come except to steal, and to kill, and to destroy. I have come that they may have life, and that they may have it more abundantly" (John 10:10). Thieves and hired hands pretend to care for the flock while seeking only their own safety and gain, fleeing whenever danger approaches. In daily life across Timor-Leste, many young people and believers are deceived by thieves—impurity, deceit, gambling, alcohol abuse, ancestral superstitions, or worldly ambition—that rob the soul of peace and joy. Yet no false teaching or superstition can ever impart true life.

Christ proclaims, "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives His life for the sheep" (John 10:11). Knowing each of us by name, He leads us from the front and voluntarily laid down His life on the cross to rescue us from peril. Just as sheep recognize their shepherd's voice and refuse to follow strangers, redeemed believers must refuse to be swayed by the confusing voices of the world, following solely the Word of the Good Shepherd who died for us.

Casting aside lukewarm comfort and worldly complacency, we are called to entrust our whole lives to the Shepherd who gave His life for us. A community led by the Good Shepherd rejects selfish gain, cherishes one another sincerely, and walks together in true unity (laran ida). Listening closely today to the voice of Jesus, may we experience the richness of abundant life through honesty, love, and holy obedience in our homes and youth communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó rona no la'o tuir Na'i Jesus nia lian nudar Bibi Atan Di'ak, ka ó sei rona lian oin-foun sira hosi mundu, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun ne'ebé na'ok ó-nia ksolok?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you listening closely to the voice of Jesus, the Good Shepherd, or are you being led astray by worldly voices and superstitions that steal your spiritual joy?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha hahalok na'ok-teen nian, hahalok bosok, no divisaun sira, hodi lori laran-moos, perdaun, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you put away deceit, harmful habits, and division today to follow the Good Shepherd and foster honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar Bibi Atan Di'ak no Odamatan salvasaun nian, ne'ebé fó Ninia moris iha krús tanba ami. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha lian oin-foun mundu nian, na'ok-teen sira, no superstisaun. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami rona no la'o tuir Na'i Jesus nia lian, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the love of our Lord Jesus Christ, who became the Door of the sheep and the Good Shepherd who laid down His life on the cross for us. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off false worldly voices, superstitions, and the temptations of sin that destroy the soul. Guide us daily by the voice of our Good Shepherd who calls us by name, enabling us to enjoy abundant life through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and youth communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Na'i Jesus no Aman Maromak Ida De'it: Seguransa Rohan-Laek no Fiar Metin ba Kristu nia Kbiit
title.en: Jesus and the Father Are One: Eternal Security and Firm Faith in Christ's Power

theological_insight.tet: Durante Festa Dedikasaun iha Jerusalém (João 10:22-42), Na'i Jesus hatudu katak ema sira-ne'ebé la fiar ba Nia la'ós hosi Ninia bibi-lubun (10:26). Nia promete moris rohan-laek ba Ninia bibi sira no garante katak la iha ema ida mak bele hadau sira hosi Ninia liman ka hosi Aman Maromak nia liman, tanba Nia no Aman ida de'it (10:28-30). Evanjellu sobu laran-toos relijiozu no fó seguransa nakonuk ba sarani sira-ne'ebé hakbesik ba Kristu ho laran-haraik.
theological_insight.en: During the Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem (John 10:22-42), Jesus explains that unbelievers reject Him because they do not belong to His flock (10:26). He grants eternal life to His sheep and guarantees that no one can snatch them from His hand or the Father's hand, declaring His complete oneness with the Father (10:28-30). While religious leaders reject His divine identity, humble hearts beyond the Jordan believe in Him, anchoring believers in unshakable security and joyful obedience.

meditation.tet:
Iha tempu malirin, durante Festa Dedikasaun iha Jerusalém, ukun-na'in sira haleu Na'i Jesus hodi husu atu Nia hateten ho klaru se Nia mak Kristu. Jesus hatán katak Ninia hahalok sira iha Aman nia naran fó sasin ona kona-ba Nia, maibé sira la fiar tanba sira la'ós hosi Ninia bibi-lubun (João 10:25-26). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma sente laran-rua iha fiar tanba uza hahalok superstisaun nian, presaun hosi sosiedade, ka moris ki'ak. Maibé dixípulu loloos mak sira-ne'ebé rona Na'i Jesus nia lian no la'o tuir Nia ho laran-moos.

Na'i Jesus fó promesa kmanek ne'ebé lori seguransa rohan-laek ba ita-nia klamar: Nia fó moris rohan-laek ba Ninia bibi sira, no la iha ema ida mak bele hadau sira hosi Ninia liman ka hosi Aman Maromak ne'ebé boot liu hotu nia liman, tanba Nia no Aman ida de'it (João 10:28-30). Kristu nia liman no Aman Maromak nia liman kaer metin ita-nia moris. La iha buat ida—moras, ki'ak, persegisaun, ka ta'uk ba diabu no superstisaun sira—ne'ebé bele hadau ita hosi Maromak nia domin boot.

Bainhira ukun-na'in sira foti fatuk atu tuda Nia, Na'i Jesus sai hosi sira-nia leet hodi bá iha mota Jordaun nia sorin bá. Iha ne'ebá, ema barak ne'ebé ho laran-haraik mai hasoru Nia no fiar metin ba Nia (João 10:40-42). Ita presiza husik tiha foti aan, hahalok bosok, no ta'uk mundu nian. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus Kristu no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Maromak nia kbiit no dame sei leno naroman ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
During the winter Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem, people surrounded Jesus in Solomon's Porch, demanding that He declare plainly whether He was the Messiah. Jesus responded that the works He performed in His Father's name already testified to Him, yet they refused to believe because they were not among His sheep (John 10:25-26). In daily life across Timor-Leste, young people and believers sometimes experience doubt or hesitation when pressured by worldly values, poverty, or superstitious customs. True sheep of the Shepherd turn away from deceptive voices and follow Jesus' voice with sincerity.

Jesus offers believers a breathtaking promise of eternal security, assuring that He gives them eternal life, that they shall never perish, and that no one can snatch them out of His hand or the almighty hand of the Father, for He and the Father are one (John 10:28-30). Held doubly secure in the grasp of both the Son and the Father who is greater than all, believers cannot be separated from God's love by sickness, poverty, human criticism, spiritual opposition, or superstitious fear.

When hostile leaders picked up stones against Him, Jesus withdrew across the Jordan, where many humble people received His words and believed in Him (John 10:40-42). Refusing to be swayed by human hostility or worldly fear, we are called to trust the sovereign power of God alone. Resting in the absolute security of salvation, believers cast aside deceit and superstition to nurture honesty, love, and complete unity (laran ida) within their families and youth communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó sente ta'uk ba perigu, moras, ka superstisaun sira, ka ó fiar metin katak la iha ema ida ka buat ida ne'ebé bele hadau ó hosi Na'i Jesus no Aman Maromak nia liman?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, do you give in to anxiety over illness, uncertainty, or superstitious fears, or do you trust completely that nothing can snatch you from the almighty hands of the Son and the Father?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha laran-rua, hahalok bosok, no divisaun sira, hodi lori laran-moos, perdaun, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: Resting in Christ's eternal security today, how can you set aside double-mindedness, falsehood, and division to foster honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé ida de'it ho Ita-Boot, no fó promesa seguransa rohan-laek nian katak la iha ema ida bele hadau ami hosi Ita-nia liman. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha laran-rua, superstisaun sira, no ta'uk mundu nian. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami rona no la'o tuir Na'i Jesus nia lian, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who is one with You and holds us securely in His almighty hand with the promise of eternal life. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off doubt, anxiety, superstitious fear, and worldly threats. Relying wholly on Your sovereign care, grant us grace to reflect Your Kingdom's glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and youth communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Moris Hias no Moris Nian: Fiar ba Na'i Jesus no Haree Maromak nia Glória
title.en: The Resurrection and the Life: Believing in Jesus and Beholding God's Glory

theological_insight.tet: Iha João 11:1-44, Na'i Jesus hein loron rua tan molok bá iha Betánia, atu iha Lázaro nia mate nia loron haat laran Maromak nia glória bele hatudu ho kompletu (11:4, 39-40). Iha rate oin, Jesus tanis hamutuk ho sira-ne'ebé tristi (11:35) no deklara katak Nia mak Moris Hi'as no Moris (11:25-26). Bainhira Nia bolu Lázaro sai hosi rate (11:43), Kristu hatudu Ninia kbiit soberanu hodi manán mate no fó esperansa rohan-laek ba sarani sira.
theological_insight.en: In John 11:1-44, Jesus intentionally delays His arrival in Bethany until Lazarus has been in the tomb for four days so that God's glory may be unmistakably displayed where human hope ends (11:4, 39-40). Sharing deeply in human sorrow as He weeps at the grave (11:35), Christ proclaims Himself the Resurrection and the Life (11:25-26) and calls Lazarus out of the tomb (11:43), demonstrating sovereign authority over death and grounding believers in unshakable hope.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira Na'i Jesus rona katak Lázaro moras, Nia la bá kedas, maibé hein loron rua tan. Bainhira Nia to'o iha Betánia, Lázaro mate no hakoi iha rate laran to'o loron haat ona, no isin komesa dois. Marta no Maria tanis ho laran-susar tanba sira hanoin se Na'i iha ne'ebá karik, sira-nia maun la mate (João 11:21, 32). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma sente fraku no lakon esperansa bainhira hasoru moras todan, ki'ak, dezempregu, ka susar iha família laran, hodi husu tanbasá Maromak la kura kedas. Maibé Jesus nia hein la'ós tanba Nia la hanoin ita, maibé atu hatudu Maromak nia glória boot liu iha ita-nia moris.

Na'i Jesus haree Maria no povu sira tanis, no Ninia espíritu tristi tebes to'o Nia tanis hamutuk ho sira (João 11:35). Jesus hatudu laran-luak no tanis hamutuk ho sira-ne'ebé tanis, maibé Nia mós hatene Ninia kbiit kmanek. Jesus hateten ba Marta katak Nia mak moris hi'as no moris, no se nia fiar, nia sei haree Maromak nia glória (João 11:25, 40). Iha rate oin, Jesus hakilar ho lian maka'as hodi bolu Lázaro sai mai, no ema mate ne'e sai mai ho moris foun (João 11:43). Na'i Jesus mak Kbiit-Na'in ne'ebé harahun tiha mate nia koren no fó moris rohan-laek.

Ita presiza husik tiha ta'uk ba mate, superstisaun sira, hahalok bosok, no sala sira, hodi kaer metin ba Na'i Jesus nia kbiit moris hi'as nian. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste fiar metin ba Kristu no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos ba malu, Maromak nia glória sei nabilan no lori esperansa foun ba família no komunidade tomak iha Timor-Leste.
meditation.en:
Upon hearing that His beloved friend Lazarus was sick, Jesus waited two more days, arriving in Bethany only after Lazarus had been dead and buried for four days. Grief-stricken, Martha and Mary lamented that their brother would not have died had the Lord been present (John 11:21, 32). In daily life across Timor-Leste, young people and believers similarly feel discouraged when facing severe poverty, family illness, academic or business setbacks, or prolonged hardship, wondering why God has not yet intervened. Yet Christ's delay is never indifference; it is a purposeful season of grace designed to reveal God's greater glory precisely where human strength reaches its end.

Deeply moved in spirit as He saw Mary and the mourners weeping, Jesus wept alongside them (John 11:35), revealing His tender compassion as well as His holy resolve against death. Declaring Himself to be the Resurrection and the Life, He called Martha to believe so that she might see the glory of God (John 11:25-26, 40). Standing before the tomb, Christ commanded Lazarus to come forth, and the dead man walked out alive (John 11:43). Before the Lord of resurrection and life, every chain of death and despair collapses.

Refusing to surrender to worldly fatalism or a culture of fear, we are called to trust fully in Christ's resurrection power. Empowered by the risen Lord, believers bear one another's sorrows and cultivate honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within their families and youth communities. By rolling away the stones of despair, superstition, and unbelief today, may we step out of every dark grave at Christ's voice and boldly proclaim God's glory.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó tanis no lakon esperansa iha susar no mate nia oin, ka ó fiar metin katak Na'i Jesus mak Moris Hi'as no Moris Nian ne'ebé bele lori Maromak nia glória ba ó-nia moris?
reflection_questions.en: Are you feeling discouraged by unanswered prayers or hopeless circumstances today, or are you trusting that Jesus is the Resurrection and the Life who will reveal God's glory in your situation?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele hasai tiha fatuk ta'uk nian, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira, hodi tanis hamutuk ho sira-ne'ebé tanis no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you roll away the stones of despair, superstition, and unbelief today, weeping with those who weep while fostering honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar Moris Hi'as no Moris Nian, ne'ebé harahun tiha mate nia kbiit no fakar sai Maromak nia glória kmanek. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha ta'uk ba mate, superstisaun sira, no hahalok bosok nian. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami rona Na'i Jesus nia lian, sai hosi rate nakukun nian, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Resurrection and the Life, who shattered the power of death and calls us out of the grave of despair into eternal life. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to joyfully roll away the stones of fear, superstition, and sinful habits. Comforted by the Savior who weeps with us, grant us grace to look steadfastly to our risen Lord and boldly proclaim Your Kingdom's glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and youth communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Maromak nia Oan nia Mate atu Halibur Ema Hotu hodi Sai Ida De'it: Kristu nia Sakrifísiu Kmanek no Uniaun Kompletu
title.en: The Death of God's Son to Gather All into One: Christ's Atoning Sacrifice and Complete Unity

theological_insight.tet: Hafoin Lázaro moris hi'as, ulun-na'in relijiozu sira halibur aan hodi planeia atu oho Na'i Jesus tanba ta'uk lakon sira-nia kbiit no fatin (João 11:47-48). Maski saserdote boot Kaifas ko'alia ho motivu polítiku atu ema ida mate ba nasaun tomak (11:50), Maromak uza nia hodi fó sai profesia katak Jesus sei mate la'ós de'it ba nasaun ne'e, maibé mós atu halibur Maromak nia oan sira ne'ebé namkari sai ida de'it (11:51-52). Maromak nia soberania laran-di'ak muda ema nia planu aat sai salvasaun, no sakrifísiu krús nian sobu egoízmu atu harii komunidade santu iha uniaun.
theological_insight.en: Following Lazarus' resurrection, religious leaders plot to kill Jesus out of fear of losing their Temple authority and national standing (John 11:47-48). Though High Priest Caiaphas speaks out of political expediency that one man should die for the people (11:50), God uses his office to prophesy Christ's substitutionary atonement—dying not only for that nation, but to gather into one all the scattered children of God (11:51-52). God's good sovereignty turns human schemes into redemptive triumph, dismantling self-preservation to unite believers in self-giving love.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira ema Judeu barak haree Lázaro moris hi'as no fiar ba Na'i Jesus, xefe saserdote sira no Farizeu sira halo enkontru no sente ta'uk dehan, "Se ita husik Nia hanesan ne'e, ema hotu sei fiar ba Nia. No ema Roma sira sei mai no hasai ita-nia fatin no ita-nia nasaun" (João 11:48). Sira ta'uk lakon sira-nia estatutu, kbiit, no fatin iha Templu laran. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma sente ta'uk lakon sira-nia kbiit, riku-soin, ka amizade sira, hodi tuir hahalok bosok, uza lian aat, ka husik tiha lia-loos evanjellu nian tanba buka de'it aan rasik nia di'ak. Maibé buka aan rasik nia di'ak mak dalan ne'ebé haketak ita hosi Maromak nia domin.

Kaifas ne'ebé saserdote boot iha tinan ne'ebá dehan, "Di'ak liu ema ida mate tanba povu ne'e, duké nasaun tomak lakon" (João 11:50). Kaifas ko'alia nune'e tanba buka de'it polítika no aan rasik nia di'ak, maibé Maromak uza ninia lian hodi fó sai profesia kmanek katak Na'i Jesus sei mate iha krús tanba nasaun ne'e no atu "halibur hamutuk Maromak nia oan sira ne'ebé namkari ba rai li'ur hodi sai ida de'it" (João 11:52). Mundu so'e sasin aat no oho ema seluk atu proteje aan rasik, maibé Na'i Jesus sakrifika Ninia aan rasik iha krús atu fó salvasaun no halo ita hotu sai ida de'it iha Maromak nia oin.

Ita presiza husik tiha hahalok aan-ian, bosok, no buka aan rasik nia di'ak, hodi entrega ita-nia moris tomak ba Na'i Jesus ne'ebé mate tanba ita. Komunidade sarani ne'ebé simu Kristu nia sakrifísiu la moris iha divizaun ka ta'uk ba kbiit mundu nian, maibé moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos ba malu. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste kaer metin ba Kristu nia sakrifísiu no moris iha uniaun loloos iha família no komunidade tomak, Maromak nia bensaun no ksolok sei naroman ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
When many witnessed Lazarus raised from the dead and believed in Jesus, the religious leaders felt threatened and convened the Sanhedrin. Fearing that everyone would believe in Him and that the Romans would take away both their place and nation (John 11:48), they sought to protect their Temple privileges and worldly security. In daily life across Timor-Leste, young people and believers can face similar temptations to compromise honesty, resort to deceit, or judge others in order to safeguard personal advantage, status, or social standing. Yet a mindset driven by self-preservation runs counter to the spirit of the cross.

High Priest Caiaphas argued out of political calculation that it was expedient for one man to die for the people so that the whole nation would not perish (John 11:50). Even through this wicked scheme, God sovereignly prophesied that Jesus' death on the cross would gather together into one all the scattered children of God (John 11:52). While the world sacrifices others to save itself, Jesus willingly laid down His own life to rescue us and unite us before God.

Setting aside selfish calculation and fear-driven self-protection, we are called to surrender our whole lives to the Savior who gave everything for us. Redeemed by Christ's atoning blood, believers lay down pride and division to love one another sincerely and walk in true unity (laran ida). Surrendering personal privilege at the foot of the cross today, may we serve our families and youth communities in honesty and self-giving love.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó buka proteje de'it ó-nia aan rasik, estatutu, ka riku-soin hodi husik tiha laran-moos, ka ó tau fiar metin ba Maromak nia kbiit ne'ebé ukun buat hotu?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you tempted to compromise honesty to protect your own interests, status, or security, or do you trust wholly in God's sovereign goodness over all circumstances?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha divizaun, hahalok aan-ian, no hahalok bosok sira, hodi lori laran-moos, perdaun, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: Following Christ's self-giving sacrifice today, how can you put aside selfish pride, deceit, and division to foster honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé fó Ninia aan nudar sakrifísiu kmanek iha krús hodi halibur Maromak nia oan sira ne'ebé namkari atu sai ida de'it. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha buka aan rasik nia di'ak, hahalok bosok, no divisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami kaer metin ba Na'i Jesus nia sakrifísiu, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no fidelidade iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for Your sovereign wisdom that accomplished our redemption even through human schemes, uniting Your scattered children by the blood of Jesus Christ on the cross. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off selfish self-preservation, fear of losing status, deceit, and division. Following the sacrificial love of our Savior who gave His life for us, grant us grace to reflect Your Kingdom's glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and youth communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Sakrifísiu Domin Kmanek nian no Fuan ne'ebé Fó Onra Loloos ba Kristu: Fiar Metin ba Na'i Jesus no Husik Tiha Hahalok Aan-ian
title.en: The Precious Sacrifice of Love and Wholehearted Devotion to Christ: Trusting Jesus and Forsaking Greed

theological_insight.tet: Loron neen molok Páskua iha Betánia (João 12:1-11), Maria fui mina-morin nardu moos folin-boot ba Na'i Jesus nia ain no hamaran ho ninia fuuk (12:3), hodi prepara ba Kristu nia loron hakoi nian (12:7). Kontráriu ho Maria nia domin laran-moos, Judas Iskariotes kritika nia hodi subar ninia laran-kaan no na'ok (12:5-6), no saserdote boot sira planeia atu oho Lázaro ne'ebé moris hi'as ona (12:10). Fiar loloos rekoñese Kristu nudar rikusoin aas liu hotu no entrega moris tomak ba Nia ho ksolok.
theological_insight.en: Six days before Passover in Bethany (John 12:1-11), Mary pours costly pure spikenard oil on Jesus' feet and wipes them with her hair (12:3), preparing Him for the day of His burial (12:7). In sharp contrast to Mary's wholehearted devotion, Judas Iscariot criticizes her out of concealed greed and theft (12:5-6), while the chief priests conspire to kill the risen Lazarus (12:10). Genuine faith treasures Christ above all earthly wealth, dismantling religious hypocrisy through joyful, unreserved surrender to Him.

meditation.tet:
Loron neen molok Páskua, bainhira Na'i Jesus iha Betánia ho Lázaro ne'ebé moris hi'as ona, sira halo festa boot ida. Iha festa ne'e nia leet, Maria foti mina-morin nardu moos ne'ebé karun tebes (folin denáriu atus tolu), fui ba Na'i Jesus nia ain, no hamaran Ninia ain ho ninia fuuk (João 12:3). Uma tomak nakonu ho mina nia morin. Maria fó ninia riku-soin kmanek liu no ninia fuuk ne'ebé nudar onra atu kose Jesus nia ain. Ba Maria, Na'i Jesus mak rikusoin kmanek liu no Na'i ne'ebé merese simu domin no onra hotu hosi ninia klamar.

Maibé Judas Iskariotes tesi lia aat ba Maria dehan, "Tanba sá mak la fa'an mina-morin ne'e ho folin denáriu atus tolu, no fó ba ema ki'ak?" (João 12:5). Evanjellu hatudu ho klaru katak Judas dehan nune'e la'ós tanba nia hanoin ema ki'ak, maibé tanba nia mak na'ok-teen ne'ebé foti osan hosi kofre ba ninia aan rasik (João 12:6). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira dalaruma monu iha tentasaun hanesan Judas, hodi uza ábitu sarani iha li'ur de'it atu buka aan rasik nia di'ak, osan, estatutu, ka hahalok bosok sira. Maibé fuan ne'ebé nakonu ho aan-ian no laran-makerek la bele haburas ksolok loloos iha Kristu.

Na'i Jesus defende Maria dehan, "Husik nia ba. Nia hanoin atu rai ida-ne'e ba loron ne'ebé hakoi Ha'u" (João 12:7). Maria nia domin kmanek lori onra boot ba Na'i Jesus nia sakrifísiu iha krús. Ita presiza husik tiha fiar toos, hahalok aan-ian, no laran-rua mundu nian, hodi fó ita-nia fuan, tempu, no moris tomak nudar sakrifísiu kmanek ba Na'i Jesus. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste so'e tiha hahalok aan-ian no bosok, hodi moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Na'i Jesus nia glória no naroman sei suli sai ksolok kmanek ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
Six days before Passover, a supper was held in Bethany where Jesus dined with Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead. There, Mary took a pound of costly oil of pure spikenard—worth three hundred denarii, a full year's wages—anointed Jesus' feet, and wiped them with her hair, filling the entire house with its fragrance (John 12:3). By offering her most precious possession alongside her hair, a woman's glory, Mary laid all her honor and life at Christ's feet because He was her supreme treasure.

Yet Judas Iscariot objected, asking why the fragrant oil was not sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor (John 12:5). Scripture exposes that Judas spoke not out of care for the poor, but because he was a thief who kept the money box and stole from it (John 12:6). In daily life across Timor-Leste, believers and young people can face the same temptation to mask selfish ambition, greed, or pursuit of status behind pious words. Outward religious appearances filled with self-interest can never delight the Lord.

Defending Mary's devotion, Jesus declared, "Let her alone; she has kept this for the day of My burial" (John 12:7), honoring her act as preparation for His sacrificial death on the cross. Laying aside lukewarm calculation and stinginess, we are called to break open the alabaster jar of our lives before the Savior who gave His life for us. As believers reject greed and hypocrisy to serve one another in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida), the fragrance of Christ's Kingdom fills our homes and youth communities.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó moris ho fuan aan-ian no buka aan rasik nia di'ak hanesan Judas, ka ó haksolok atu fó ó-nia riku-soin, tempu, no domin kmanek liu ba Na'i Jesus hanesan Maria?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you letting worldly calculation and self-interest govern your faith like Judas, or are you joyfully offering your life and finest devotion at Jesus' feet like Mary?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha hahalok aan-ian, laran-makerek, no hahalok bosok sira, hodi lori laran-moos, sakrifísiu domin nian, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How can you turn away from hypocrisy, greed, and critical attitudes today, practicing sincere devotion to Christ through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fó agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé merese simu ita-nia domin, onra, no moris tomak. Tulun foin-sa'e no povu sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha hahalok aan-ian Judas nian, laran-makerek, no hahalok bosok sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami fakar sai mina-morin domin nian iha Na'i Jesus nia ain, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for our precious Lord Jesus Christ, who gave His body and blood for us on the cross. Help the young people and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off worldly greed, stinginess, hypocrisy, and falsehood. Like Mary, grant us joy to pour out the finest alabaster jar of our time, resources, and obedience at Jesus' feet, spreading the fragrance of Your Kingdom through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in our homes and youth communities. We pray in the name of our Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.

title.tet: Trigu Musan ne'ebé Mate hodi Fo Fuan Barak no Liurai Humilde: Fiar ba Naroman no Tuir Na'i Jesus
title.en: The Grain of Wheat That Dies to Bear Much Fruit and the Humble King: Believing in the Light and Following the Lord Jesus

theological_insight.tet: Na'i Jesus tama ba Jerusalém hodi sa'e kuda-buru oan ho laran-haraik, hodi hatudu katak Ninia reinu la'ós reinu polítika mundu nian, maibé reinu salvasaun nian liu hosi krús. Hanesan trigu musan ne'ebé tenke monu ba rai no mate atu bele fo fuan barak, Kristu nia mate iha krús duni sai liurai mundu ne'e nian no loke dalan ba ema Judeu no ema jentiu hotu atu hetan moris rohan-laek. Fiar ba Na'i Jesus katak ita nega ita-nia aan rasik, husik tiha ksolok no foti aan mundu nian, hodi simu Kristu nudar riku-soin aas liu hotu no la'o iha Ninia naroman nudar naroman nia oan sira.
theological_insight.en: The Lord Jesus enters Jerusalem humbly on a young donkey, demonstrating that His kingdom is not a worldly political empire, but a redemptive reign established through the cross. Just as a grain of wheat must fall into the earth and die to bear much fruit, Christ's substitutionary death drives out the ruler of this world and brings eternal salvation to both Jews and Gentiles. True discipleship means embracing holy self-denial—hating our self-centered lives in this world, treasuring Christ above all earthly comfort, and walking in His light as children of light.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira Na'i Jesus sa'e kuda-buru oan tama ba Jerusalém, ema lubun boot foti ai-palma sanak sira hodi hakilar ho ksolok dehan, "Hosana! Bensaun ba Nia ne'ebé mai hodi Na'i nia naran, ba Liurai hosi Israel!" (João 12:13). Ema barak hanoin katak Jesus sei sai liurai mundu nian ne'ebé lori kbiit polítika no riku-soin. Maibé Na'i Jesus sa'e kuda-buru ho laran-haraik, hodi hatudu katak Ninia tronu mak krús ne'ebé fo salvasaun ba klamar sira. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma buka Jesus tanba hakarak estatutu, riku-soin, ka buka de'it aan rasik nia di'ak. Maibé Jesus la'ós lori ksolok mohu mundu nian, maibé fo moris rohan-laek liu hosi Ninia sakrifísiu.

Bainhira ema Gregu sira mai buka Jesus, Na'i Jesus fo sai lia-loos kmanek dehan katak oras to'o ona atu Ema nia Oan simu glória. Hanesan trigu musan ne'ebé monu ba rai no mate hodi fo fuan barak, Kristu nia mate iha krús lori moris foun no salvasaun ba ema hotu. Ema ne'ebé hadomi ninia moris iha mundu ne'e sei lakon ninia moris, maibé ema ne'ebé nega ninia aan rasik tanba Kristu sei kaer nafatin to'o moris rohan-laek.

Ita presiza husik tiha hahalok aan-ian, foti aan, uza tua demais, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira, hodi fo ita-nia moris tomak nudar trigu musan ne'ebé obedese ba Kristu. Na'i Jesus fo hatene ho domin atu ita fiar ba naroman bainhira ita sei iha naroman ne'e, atu nune'e ita bele sai naroman nia oan sira. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste fiar metin ba Kristu nia naroman no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Maromak nia glória sei fakar sai ksolok no esperansa foun ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
When the Lord Jesus entered Jerusalem riding on a young donkey, a great crowd took palm branches and shouted with joy, "Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!" (John 12:13). Many expected Jesus to be an earthly king who would bring political power and material prosperity. Yet Jesus rode a humble donkey, revealing that His true throne is the cross that brings salvation to our souls. Even in Timor-Leste today, young people and believers can be tempted to treat faith as a means for social status, financial gain, or personal comfort. However, Jesus is not a charm for worldly desires; He is the crucified King who gave His life to grant us eternal life.

When Greeks came seeking Jesus during the festival, the Lord declared that the hour had come for the Son of Man to be glorified. Just as a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies to produce a rich harvest, Christ's death on the cross yielded the fruit of eternal salvation for countless people. Whoever loves his life in this world will lose it, while the one who denies himself for the sake of Christ will keep it for eternal life.

We are called to abandon lukewarm comfort, selfishness, pride, deceit, and superstition, offering our lives like a grain of wheat in joyful obedience to Christ. Jesus urges us to believe in the light while we have the light, so that we may become children of light. As believers and youth in Timor-Leste trust fully in the light of Christ and walk together in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities, God's glory will shine forth with renewed hope across the nation.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó kaer metin ba aan rasik nia di'ak no foti aan mundu nian, ka ó husik ó-nia fuan sai nudar trigu musan ne'ebé mate hodi fo fuan barak iha Na'i Jesus nia oin?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you holding tightly to personal comfort and worldly gain, or are you surrendering yourself like a grain of wheat to bear fruit for the Lord Jesus?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha nakukun hahalok bosok nian, hahalok aan-ian, no superstisaun sira, hodi la'o iha naroman no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you cast off the darkness of dishonesty, selfishness, and superstition today, walking in the light to foster genuine love and unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar Liurai humilde, no fo Ninia moris nudar trigu musan ne'ebé mate iha krús hodi lori salvasaun kmanek ba ami. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha foti aan mundu nian, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami fiar ba Na'i Jesus nia naroman, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who came as our humble King and gave His life like a grain of wheat upon the cross to bring us wonderful salvation. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off worldly pride, self-preservation, dishonesty, and superstition. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we may believe in the light of Jesus and live in true unity (laran ida), love, and purity within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Fiar ba Naroman no Hadomi Maromak nia Glória: Husik Tiha Ta'uk ba Ema no Rona Na'i Jesus nia Liafuan
title.en: Believing in the Light and Loving God's Glory: Casting Off the Fear of Man and Hearing the Word of the Lord Jesus

theological_insight.tet: Maski Na'i Jesus halo sinál milagre barak, ema Judeu sira-nia fuan toos hodi kumpre profeta Isaías nia liafuan. Ukun-na'in balu fiar duni ba Jesus, maibé sira subar sira-nia fiar tanba hadomi liu glória hosi ema duké glória hosi Maromak. Hadomi ema nia gaba no ta'uk ba ema nia oin mak idolatria ida ne'ebé hamate klamar nia ksolok no liberdade. Na'i Jesus hatudu aan nudar naroman mundu nian no fó avizu katak Ninia liafuan rasik mak dalan salvasaun nian, maibé ba ema ne'ebé rejeita Nia, liafuan ne'e sei sai sasin hodi tesi lia iha loron ikus.
theological_insight.en: Despite witnessing many miraculous signs, the people persisted in hardened unbelief, fulfilling the prophecies of Isaiah. Even among the authorities who believed in Jesus, fear of exclusion kept them silent because they loved the glory that comes from man more than the glory that comes from God. Craving human approval is a soul-enslaving idolatry that robs believers of true joy and freedom. Jesus proclaims Himself as the Light of the world, declaring that His word brings eternal life to those who believe, yet stands as the righteous standard of judgment on the last day for those who reject Him.

meditation.tet:
Maski Na'i Jesus halo milagre barak iha ema Judeu sira nia oin, sira-nia fuan toos no sira la fiar nafatin ba Nia. Iha mós ukun-na'in balu ne'ebé fiar ba Jesus, maibé sira la brani atu fo sai sira-nia fiar tanba ta'uk ema Farizeu sira duni sai sira hosi sinagoga. Evanjelhu hatudu ho naroman dehan, "Sira hadomi liu glória hosi ema duké glória hosi Maromak" (João 12:43). Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma sente ta'uk ba ema nia oin, ta'uk família ka komunidade nia ko'alia aat, ka ta'uk husik tiha superstisaun no kultura lulik sira. Maibé buka glória no gaba hosi ema duké Maromak nia glória lori ita-nia klamar ba nakukun no fraku.

Na'i Jesus hakilar ho lian maka'as dehan katak Nia mai iha mundu nudar naroman, atu ema ne'ebé fiar ba Nia sei la hela iha nakukun laran, no Aman Maromak nia ukun-fuan mak moris rohan-laek. Glória mundu nian sei mohu ho lalais hanesan ai-funan ne'ebé namlaik, maibé Na'i Jesus nia liafuan mak naroman no moris rohan-laek ba ita-nia klamar. Nia fo avizu kmanek katak ema ne'ebé rejeita Kristu no la simu Ninia liafuan, liafuan ne'e rasik mak sei tesi lia ba nia iha loron ikus.

Ita presiza husik tiha ta'uk ba ema nia oin, hahalok bosok, uza tua demais, no superstisaun sira, hodi fo fuan tomak ba Maromak nia glória. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus nia naroman no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Maromak nia glória kmanek sei fakar sai naroman no salvasaun loloos ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
Even after the Lord Jesus performed many signs before their eyes, the people hardened their hearts and refused to believe in Him. Furthermore, while many among the authorities did believe in Jesus, they feared being cast out by the Pharisees and refused to confess their faith openly. Scripture exposes the root cause plainly: "they loved the glory that comes from man more than the glory that comes from God" (John 12:43). In Timor-Leste today, young people and believers often face similar pressure—fearing social rejection, criticism from relatives or neighbors, or isolation when turning away from ancestral worship and superstitious traditions. Yet seeking human praise above God's glory is a subtle trap that weakens the soul.

Jesus cried out boldly, declaring that He came into the world as light so that whoever believes in Him may not remain in darkness, and that the Father's commandment is eternal life. Earthly praise withers like grass, whereas the life-giving word of Christ endures forever. At the same time, Jesus gives a solemn warning: the very word He has spoken will judge on the last day anyone who rejects Him and refuses to receive His truth.

We must cast off lukewarm compromise and the fear of human disapproval, standing courageously for the Savior who gave His life for us. When believers seek God's glory above human applause, hypocrisy fades, giving way to honesty, love, and genuine unity (laran ida) within our families and youth communities. Let us lay aside every fear of man today, cling wholeheartedly to the light of Christ's word, and shine faithfully for His glory.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó hadomi liu glória no gaba hosi ema hodi subar ó-nia fiar, ka ó fiar metin hodi buka Maromak nia glória no la'o iha Na'i Jesus nia naroman?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, do you love human praise and social approval more than God, hiding your faith, or are you casting off the fear of man to walk boldly in the light of Christ?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha ta'uk ba ema nia oin, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira, hodi lori laran-moos, brani nudar naroman nia oan, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you set aside the fear of people's opinions, deceit, and superstitious compromises today, practicing honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar naroman mundu nian no lori ukun-fuan moris rohan-laek nian ba ami. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha ta'uk ba ema nia oin, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami hadomi Maromak nia glória liu fali glória mundu nian, no moris iha uniaun (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who came as the Light of the world to rescue us from darkness and give us the commandment of eternal life. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off the fear of human disapproval, dishonesty, and superstition. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we may treasure Your Word above all else, loving Your glory more than the praise of men, and shining together in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Na'i Jesus nia Domin ho Servisu Haraik-Aan: Fasi Maluk Sira nia Ain no Halo Tuir Na'i nia Ezemplu
title.en: The Lord Jesus' Humble Love and Service: Washing One Another's Feet and Following His Example

theological_insight.tet: Molok terus iha krús, Na'i Jesus hatudu domin to'o rohan hodi hakne'ak no fasi Ninia eskolante sira-nia ain, servisu ida ne'ebé baibain atan ki'ik sira mak halo. Maski Nia simu ona kbiit hotu hosi Aman Maromak, Nia hili atu hatún aan hodi hanorin katak sarani sira ne'ebé hetan ona salvasaun tenke hamoos aan loron-loron hosi sala mundu nian no serví malu ho laran-haraik. Ksolok no bensaun loloos iha Maromak nia reinu la mai hosi ukun ema seluk, maibé mai hosi halo tuir Kristu nia ezemplu hodi serví maluk sira iha domin no uniaun.
theological_insight.en: On the eve of the cross, the Lord Jesus demonstrates love to the uttermost by kneeling to wash His disciples' feet—a task reserved for the lowest household servant. Fully aware of His sovereign authority from the Father, Christ humbles Himself to illustrate both decisive cleansing through salvation and the believer's daily need for spiritual purification from worldly sin. True joy and lasting blessing in God's kingdom are found not in lording status over others, but in joyful, counter-cultural obedience that washes one another's feet in genuine love.

meditation.tet:
Molok Festa Páskua, Na'i Jesus hatene katak Ninia oras to'o ona atu husik mundu ne'e hodi fila ba Aman. Nia hadomi Ninia eskolante sira no hadomi sira to'o rohan. Maski Jesus hatene katak Aman Maromak fo ona buat hotu ba Ninia liman, Nia hamriik hosi meza, hasai Ninia ropa li'ur, kesi toalha ida iha kanotak, no fui bee ba basia hodi komesa fasi eskolante sira-nia ain. Iha tempu ne'ebá, fasi ema nia ain mak servisu ne'ebé ki'ik liu hosi atan sira nian. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma buka estatutu, foti aan, ka hakarak ema seluk serví sira tanba pozisaun, tinan, ka kbiit família nian. Maibé Na'i Jesus, ne'ebé nudar Na'i no Mestre, hatudu laran-haraik boot hodi serví no fasi Ninia eskolante sira-nia ain.

Pedro lakohi Jesus fasi ninia ain, maibé Jesus hatán katak se Nia la fasi Pedro, Pedro sei la hamutuk ho Nia. Ema ne'ebé hariis ona—katak simu ona perdoan no salvasaun iha Kristu—presiza nafatin fasi ninia ain loron-loron hosi fo'er no sala mundu nian. Na'i Jesus fo ezemplu klaru atu ita ne'ebé simu ona Ninia grasa tenke halo tuir Nia hodi serví malu ho laran-luak no haraik-aan.

Ita presiza husik tiha foti aan, hahalok bosok, uza tua demais, no superstisaun sira, hodi tuir Na'i Jesus nia ezemplu laran-haraik nian. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste soe tiha hahalok foti aan no serví malu ho laran-haraik iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Na'i Jesus nia glória no dame sei nabilan no fakar sai bensaun ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
Just before the Passover Festival, the Lord Jesus knew that His hour had come to depart from this world and return to the Father, and He loved His own to the very end. Though fully conscious that the Father had placed all things under His sovereign hands, Jesus rose from the supper table, laid aside His outer garments, tied a towel around His waist, poured water into a basin, and began to wash His disciples' feet. In that culture, washing dusty feet was the humblest duty assigned to the lowest servant. Even in Timor-Leste today, young people and believers can fall into worldly pride—demanding respect based on age, social rank, or family status. Yet the Lord of heaven and earth knelt down in the form of a servant to cleanse His followers.

When Peter initially protested in astonishment, Jesus replied that unless He washed him, Peter could have no share with Him. Just as someone who has bathed only needs to wash dusty feet, believers who have been decisively cleansed through Christ's blood still need daily repentance and renewal from the stains of worldly sin. Jesus left us an unmistakable pattern: since He, as Lord and Teacher, washed our feet, we ought also to wash one another's feet.

True discipleship never grasps for higher seats of privilege; instead, it stoops low to bear one another's burdens with grace. When a community experiences the sacrificial love of Christ, pride and social barriers dissolve into honesty, mutual care, and wholehearted unity (laran ida). Let us lay down every trace of arrogance before the cross today and joyfully serve our families and neighbors with the humble heart of Jesus.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó buka foti aan no hakarak ema seluk serví ó, ka ó fo fuan laran-haraik hodi serví no fasi maluk sira-nia ain hanesan Na'i Jesus?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you clinging to pride and expecting others to serve you, or are you stooping in humility to serve your brothers and sisters like the Lord Jesus?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha foti aan, hahalok bosok, no divisaun sira, hodi lori laran-haraik, servisu domin nian, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you set aside pride, deceit, and division today, actively practicing humble service, honesty, and genuine unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé hadomi ami to'o rohan, no hatudu laran-haraik boot hodi fasi eskolante sira-nia ain. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha foti aan, estatutu mundu nian, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami loron-loron simu perdoan foun, no serví malu ho laran-haraik nudar maun-alin iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who loved us to the uttermost and demonstrated profound humility by washing His disciples' feet. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off worldly status, pride, dishonesty, and superstition. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we may receive daily spiritual cleansing through Christ's grace, and faithfully serve one another in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Hadomi Malu nudar Na'i Jesus nia Ukun-Fuan Foun: Husik Tiha Bosok no Foti Aan, Hodi Moris iha Domin Kmanek Kristu nian
title.en: Loving One Another as the Lord Jesus' New Commandment: Casting Off Betrayal and Boasting to Live in Christ's Sacrificial Love

theological_insight.tet: Iha meza haan kalan ikus, Na'i Jesus fó sai ho laran-susar katak Judas sei fa'an Nia. Bainhira Judas sai ba li'ur, rai kalan ona—ida-ne'e hatudu nakukun espirituál ba ema ne'ebé hili osan no sala duké Kristu. Liu tiha ne'e, Na'i Jesus fó Ukun-Fuan Foun atu ita hadomi malu hanesan Nia hadomi ita liu hosi sakrifísiu iha krús; domin ne'e mak sai sinál ba mundu katak ita mak Ninia eskolante loloos. Entretantu, Pedro nia promete maka'as atu mate tanba Jesus hatudu ema nia frakeza, hodi hanorin katak ita labele sadere ba ita-nia kbiit rasik, maibé ba Kristu nia grasa de'it.
theological_insight.en: During the final supper, the Lord Jesus sorrowfully foretells Judas's betrayal, and as Judas departs into the night, Scripture highlights the spiritual darkness of trading Christ for worldly gain. Immediately afterward, Jesus reveals the glory of the cross and gives His disciples a New Commandment: to love one another with the same sacrificial standard with which He loved us—the defining badge of true discipleship. Meanwhile, Peter's self-confident boast is met with the prophecy of his threefold denial, exposing the fragility of human willpower and teaching believers to rely solely on Christ's sustaining grace.

meditation.tet:
Iha meza haan kalan, Na'i Jesus laran-susar iha espíritu no fo sai ho naroman dehan, "Ema ida hosi imi sei fa'an Hau" (João 13:21). Judas Iskariotes simu paun pedasuk ne'ebé Jesus habokon, no diabu tama kedas iha ninia fuan. Bainhira Judas sai ba li'ur, Evanjelhu hatudu ho laran-triste dehan, "No rai kalan ona" (João 13:30). Husik tiha Na'i Jesus ne'ebé nudar Naroman Mundu nian hodi buka osan, kbiit, ka aan rasik nia di'ak, lori ema ba nakukun no mate nia laran. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma monu iha tentasaun atu fa'an sira-nia fiar, uza hahalok bosok, uza tua demais, ka tuir hahalok aan-ian hodi husik tiha Kristu. Maibé moris dook hosi Kristu mak moris iha nakukun laran.

Bainhira Judas sai tiha, Na'i Jesus fo Ukun-Fuan Foun ba Ninia eskolante sira atu hadomi malu hanesan Nia hadomi sira, atu nune'e ema hotu bele hatene katak sira mak Ninia eskolante loloos. Domin ne'ebé Kristu husu la'ós domin falsu mundu nian, maibé domin sakrifísiu nian ne'ebé fo moris iha krús tanba maluk sira. Pedro foti aan hodi gaba aan katak nia prontu atu fo ninia moris tanba Jesus. Maibé Jesus fo hatene ho laran-luak katak molok manu aman kokoreek, Pedro sei nega Nia dala tolu. Kbiit no laran-manas ema nian sei naksalak, maibé Kristu nia domin mak sei kaer metin ita.

Ita presiza husik tiha foti aan, laran-rua, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira, hodi kaer metin ba Na'i Jesus nia domin.
