Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste soe tiha hahalok aan-ian no traisaun, hodi moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin loloos, no laran-moos ba malu, Na'i Jesus nia glória no dame sei nabilan no fakar sai bensaun kmanek ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
While sharing the final meal with His disciples, the Lord Jesus was troubled in spirit and declared, "One of you will betray Me" (John 13:21). After walking with Jesus for three years and witnessing His grace, Judas Iscariot took the dipped morsel of bread and walked out into the night. Scripture records that moment with chilling clarity: "And it was night" (John 13:30). Abandoning Jesus, the Light of the world, for greed and deceit leads only into spiritual darkness and ruin. Even in Timor-Leste today, young people and believers can face the temptation to compromise their loyalty to Christ for quick money, fleeting desires, or worldly approval—yet stepping away from the Lord always leads into the night.

Once Judas departed, Jesus gave His disciples a New Commandment: to love one another just as He loved them, so that all people would recognize them as His true followers. This love is far deeper than empty words or passing emotion; it is the sacrificial love of the cross that stoops to wash feet and lays down its life for others. Moments later, Peter boasted in his own human passion, claiming he was ready to lay down his life for Jesus. Gently exposing the frailty of self-reliance, Jesus foretold that before the rooster crowed, Peter would deny Him three times.

Authentic discipleship never boasts in human willpower or religious zeal, but rests entirely on the redeeming love of Christ. When believers embrace His grace, hidden betrayals, gossip, and selfish pride give way to honesty, mutual care, and wholehearted unity (laran ida). Let us lay down our self-confidence before the cross today and walk faithfully in Jesus' new commandment to love one another.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó sadere ba ó-nia kbiit no laran-manas rasik hanesan Pedro, ka ó fo fuan laran-haraik hodi kaer metin ba Na'i Jesus nia domin kmanek ne'ebé perdoa ó-nia frakeza?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, do you rely on your own human strength and willpower like Peter, or do you humbly cling to the Lord Jesus' grace that forgives and sustains you?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha hahalok traisaun, bosok, no divisaun sira, hodi moris iha ukun-fuan foun nian hodi hatudu domin loloos no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you cast off hidden deceit, betrayal, and divisive habits today, practicing sacrificial love and fostering genuine unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé fo Ukun-Fuan Foun mai ami atu hadomi malu hanesan Ita-Boot hadomi ami. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha nakukun traisaun nian, hahalok foti aan, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami la sadere ba ami-nia kbiit rasik, maibé moris iha Na'i Jesus nia domin, no hatudu uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin loloos, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who gave His life for us despite our weakness and entrusted us with the New Commandment to love one another as He loved us. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off the darkness of greed, betrayal, pride, and dishonesty. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we may never trust in our own strength, but rely wholly on Christ's love, living in honesty, grace, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Na'i Jesus nudar Dalan, Lia-Loos, no Moris: Keta Laran-Susar no Fiar Metin ba Maromak nia Oan
title.en: The Lord Jesus as the Way, the Truth, and the Life: Do Not Let Your Hearts Be Troubled, Trust in God's Son

theological_insight.tet: Molok terus iha krús, Na'i Jesus fo kmaan ba eskolante sira atu sira keta laran-susar, hodi promete katak Nia baa atu prepara fatin iha Aman Maromak nia uma no sei mai fali hodi lori sira ba hamutuk ho Nia. Na'i Jesus hatudu aan nudar Dalan, Lia-Loos, no Moris ida-de'it ne'ebé lori ema ba Aman, tanba Nia no Aman mak ida de'it. Dame no ksolok loloos mai hosi fiar metin ba Kristu duké sadere ba mundu ne'e, no harohan ho fiar iha Ninia naran atu Aman hetan glória.
theological_insight.en: On the eve of His crucifixion, the Lord Jesus comforts His troubled disciples by promising to prepare a dwelling place in His Father's house and return to bring them to Himself. In a world offering countless false paths, Christ declares His exclusive authority as the sole Way, Truth, and Life to the Father, revealing His complete unity with God the Father. True peace and lasting satisfaction are found by resting in Christ's sufficient work and praying boldly in His name for the glory of God.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira Na'i Jesus atu husik mundu ne'e hodi baa Aman, Nia hatete ba Ninia eskolante sira ne'ebé ta'uk no laran-susar atu sira keta laran-susar, maibé fiar ba Maromak no fiar mós ba Nia. Na'i Jesus fo promesa kmanek katak Nia baa atu prepara fatin iha Aman nia uma ba ita, no Nia sei mai fali atu lori ita ba hela hamutuk ho Nia ba nafatin. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma moris iha laran-susar boot tanba moris kiak, moras, desempregu, ka ta'uk ba diabu no superstisaun sira. Maibé Na'i Jesus fo kmaan ne'ebé rohan-laek hodi bolu ita atu keta laran-susar, maibé fo fuan tomak hodi fiar ba Maromak no fiar ba Kristu.

Bainhira Tomé husu kona-ba dalan, Na'i Jesus hatán ho autoridade boot katak Nia mak dalan, lia-loos, no moris, no ema ida labele hakbesik ba Aman, só de'it liu hosi Nia. Mundu so'e lian oin-oin no lohi ema ho superstisaun ka riku-soin mohu nian, maibé dalan loloos ida-de'it ne'ebé lori klamar ba Maromak Aman mak Na'i Jesus Kristu. Bainhira Filipe husu atu haree Aman, Jesus hatán katak ema ne'ebé haree ona Jesus, haree tiha ona Aman Maromak, tanba Jesus hela iha Aman no Aman hela iha Jesus.

Na'i Jesus fo promesa kmanek ba ita-nia orasaun katak buat naran de'it ne'ebé ita husu hodi Ninia naran, Nia sei halo atu nune'e Aman bele hetan glória iha Oan Mane. Ita presiza husik tiha laran-susar, hahalok bosok, uza tua demais, no superstisaun sira, hodi harohan ho fiar metin iha Na'i Jesus nia naran. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste kaer metin ba Kristu nudar Dalan, Lia-Loos, no Moris, hodi moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Maromak nia glória no dame sei nabilan ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
Knowing that the hour of His suffering and departure was near, the Lord Jesus spoke gentle words of comfort to His anxious disciples, urging them not to let their hearts be troubled, but to trust in God and trust also in Him. Rather than leaving His followers abandoned, Jesus promised to prepare an eternal home for them in His Father's house and to return to bring them to Himself. In Timor-Leste today, many young people and believers carry heavy anxiety over economic hardship, family illness, uncertain futures, or lingering fears tied to superstitious traditions. Yet the Lord calls us to lay aside worldly fear and anchor our hearts wholly in the sovereign care of God the Father and His Son.

When Thomas asked how they could know the way, Jesus proclaimed one of the foundational truths of the gospel: He Himself is the Way, the Truth, and the Life, and no one comes to the Father except through Him. While the world offers countless competing paths and empty promises, salvation and genuine peace are found exclusively in Jesus Christ. When Philip asked to see the Father, Jesus revealed His complete divine unity with God, explaining that whoever has seen Him has seen the Father.

Standing firm in Christ means refusing to waver before worldly pressures, deceit, or fear. Jesus promises that whatever we ask in His name, He will do so that the Father may be glorified in the Son. When believers entrust their anxieties to the Savior, they are freed from hypocrisy and division to practice honesty, mutual care, and wholehearted unity (laran ida) within their families and communities. Let us surrender every worry to the Lord today and pray with bold confidence in the name of Jesus, our Way, Truth, and Life.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó husik ó-nia fuan laran-susar tanba moris mundu nian ka ta'uk superstisaun, ka ó fiar metin katak Na'i Jesus mak Dalan, Lia-Loos, no Moris ne'ebé prepara fatin iha lalehan ba ó?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, do you allow worldly worries or superstitious fears to trouble your heart, or do you trust firmly that Jesus is the Way, the Truth, and the Life who has prepared an eternal home for you?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha laran-susar, hahalok bosok, no divisaun sira, hodi harohan ho fiar iha Na'i Jesus nia naran no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you set aside anxiety, dishonesty, and division today, praying faithfully in the name of Jesus and fostering genuine unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar Dalan, Lia-Loos, no Moris, no fo kmaan ba ami-nia fuan atu keta laran-susar. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha laran-susar, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus, harohan hodi Ninia naran kmanek, no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who comforts our troubled hearts and stands as the sole Way, Truth, and Life leading us to You. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off anxiety about the future, deceit, and the darkness of superstition. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we may pray boldly in Jesus' name and live in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Promesa Espíritu Santu nian nudar Ajudadór no Dame Kmanek Na'i Jesus nian: Hadomi Kristu ho Hahalok Halo Tuir Ukun-Fuan
title.en: The Promise of the Holy Spirit as Helper and the Lord Jesus' Surpassing Peace: Loving Christ by Keeping His Commandments

theological_insight.tet: Molok terus iha krús, Na'i Jesus promete atu haruka Ajudadór seluk, katak Espíritu Santu lia-loos nian, hodi hela ho sarani sira ba nafatin atu sira la sai hanesan oan-kiak. Domin loloos ba Kristu hatudu liu hosi hahalok halo tuir Ninia ukun-fuan sira, no ba ema ne'ebé obedese, Aman no Oan sei mai hodi halo Sira-nia hela-fatin iha nia laran. Na'i Jesus fó Ninia dame rasik—dame ne'ebé mundu labele fó—hodi halakon laran-susar no ta'uk hotu, no hatudu katak liurai mundu ne'e nian la iha kbiit hasoru Nia.
theological_insight.en: Before His crucifixion, the Lord Jesus promises to ask the Father for another Helper—the Spirit of truth—to dwell within believers forever so they are never left as spiritual orphans. Genuine love for Christ is demonstrated not by mere sentiment, but by joyful obedience to His commandments, through which the Father and Son make their home with the believer. Furthermore, Jesus bestows His own enduring peace—a peace entirely distinct from what the fragile world offers—dispelling fear and proving that the ruler of this world holds no power over Him.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira Na'i Jesus atu husik mundu ne'e hodi baa Aman, Nia fo promesa kmanek ba Ninia disípulu sira katak Nia sei husu ba Aman atu fó Ajudadór ida seluk hodi hela ho sira to'o rohan-laek, no Nia sei la husik sira sai oan-kiak. Mundu labele simu Espíritu Santu tanba la haree no la konhese Nia, maibé sarani sira konhese Nia tanba Nia hela iha ita-nia laran hodi hanorin no fó-hanoin fali Kristu nia liafuan hotu. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma sente mesak no ta'uk tanba moris kiak, moras, ka ta'uk ba superstisaun no diabu sira. Maibé Na'i Jesus garante katak Nia nunka husik ita mesak, maibé haruka Espíritu Santu atu hametin no fó kmaan ba ita-nia klamar loron-loron.

Na'i Jesus hatudu ho klaru oinsá mak ita hatudu domin loloos ba Nia: ema ne'ebé hadomi Nia sei halo tuir Ninia ukun-fuan sira. Fiar loloos la'ós ho liafuan de'it, maibé moris tuir Na'i Jesus nia liafuan ho laran-haksolok. Bainhira ita hadomi no halo tuir Ninia ukun-fuan, Aman Maromak no Na'i Jesus sei hadomi ita no halo Sira-nia hela-fatin iha ita-nia fuan laran.

Molok hakat ba krús, Na'i Jesus fo prezente kmanek liu ba ita-nia klamar, hodi fó Ninia dame rasik ne'ebé la hanesan ho dame ne'ebé mundu fó, atu ita keta laran-susar no keta laran-ta'uk. Dame ne'ebé mundu fó hosi osan, pozisaun, ka tua mak dame pasajeiru de'it, maibé Na'i Jesus nia dame mak dame loloos ne'ebé harahun tiha ta'uk hotu. Ita presiza husik tiha laran-susar, hahalok bosok, uza tua demais, no superstisaun sira, hodi rona Espíritu Santu nia hanorin. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste halo tuir Na'i nia liafuan no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Kristu nia dame sei nabilan ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
Knowing that His departure to the Father through the cross was near, the Lord Jesus comforted His anxious disciples with an extraordinary promise: He would ask the Father to give them another Helper, the Spirit of truth, to remain with them forever, assuring them that He would never leave them as orphans. While the unbelieving world neither sees nor knows the Holy Spirit, believers know Him intimately because He dwells within them to teach and bring Christ's words to remembrance. In Timor-Leste today, young people and believers often wrestle with feelings of isolation, economic hardship, or lingering fears tied to superstitious traditions. Yet the Lord assures us that we are never abandoned; His indwelling Spirit walks beside us every single day.

Jesus also defines what authentic love for Him looks like: those who truly love Him are the ones who cherish and obey His commandments. Real faith goes far beyond empty words; it is proven by joyful obedience to the truth of Scripture. To those who walk in faithful obedience, the Lord promises that both the Father and the Son will love them and make their spiritual home within their hearts.

Before facing the cross, Jesus bequeathed His greatest gift to His people—His own peace, a peace utterly unlike the fragile comfort the world offers, freeing us from troubled and fearful hearts. Worldly peace built on money, status, or fleeting pleasures vanishes when storms arise, whereas Christ's peace anchors the soul eternally. When believers listen to the Holy Spirit and obey Christ's word, deceit and division give way to honesty, love, and wholehearted unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. Let us yield to the Spirit's guidance today and walk boldly in the unshakeable peace of Christ.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó sente mesak no ta'uk nudar oan-kiak, ka ó fiar metin katak Espíritu Santu nudar Ajudadór hela iha ó-nia laran hodi fo dame ne'ebé mundu labele fo?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, do you feel alone and fearful like a spiritual orphan, or do you trust firmly that the Holy Spirit dwells within you to give a peace the world cannot provide?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha laran-susar, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira, hodi halo tuir Na'i Jesus nia ukun-fuan sira no lori uniaun (laran ida) no dame ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you set aside anxiety, dishonesty, and superstitious fears today, obeying Christ's commandments by the Spirit's power to bring peace and true unity (laran ida) to your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé haruka Ajudadór, katak Espíritu Santu, atu hela iha ami-nia laran hodi hanorin no fo dame kmanek ba ami. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha sente oan-kiak, laran-susar, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami hadomi Na'i Jesus hodi halo tuir Ninia ukun-fuan sira, no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who did not leave us as orphans but sent the Holy Spirit as our Helper to dwell within us and grant us His peace. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off loneliness, anxiety, deceit, and the darkness of superstition. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we may love Jesus by joyfully keeping His commandments, living in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Na'i Jesus nudar Uvas-Huun Loloos no Ita nudar Sanak Sira: Hela iha Kristu nia Domin hodi Fo Fuan Barak
title.en: The Lord Jesus as the True Vine and Us as the Branches: Abiding in Christ's Love to Bear Much Fruit

theological_insight.tet: Na'i Jesus hatudu aan nudar Uvas-Huun Loloos, Aman Maromak nudar to'os-na'in, no sarani sira nudar sanak sira. Hanesan sanak ne'ebé labele fo fuan mesak se haketak aan hosi uvas-huun, ita labele halo buat ida ne'ebé iha folin rohan-laek se dook hosi Kristu. To'os-na'in hamoos sanak ne'ebé fo fuan liu hosi Ninia liafuan atu bele fo fuan barak liután. Ksolok nakonu iha moris sarani la mai hosi ema nia kbiit rasik, maibé mai hosi hela nafatin iha Na'i Jesus nia domin, halo tuir Ninia ukun-fuan sira, no hadomi malu hanesan belun loloos ne'ebé Nia hili ona.
theological_insight.en: The Lord Jesus reveals Himself as the True Vine, God the Father as the vinedresser, and believers as the branches. Just as a branch cannot bear fruit apart from the vine, believers can accomplish nothing of eternal value detached from Christ. The Father prunes fruitful branches through His Word so they yield even greater spiritual fruit, while unfruitful branches are removed. Fullness of joy is found not in self-reliant striving, but in abiding in Christ's love, obeying His commandments, and loving one another sacrificially as chosen friends of the Savior.

meditation.tet:
Na'i Jesus fo sai ai-knanoik kmanek ba Ninia eskolante sira hodi dehan katak Nia mak uvas-huun loloos, Aman Maromak mak to'os-na'in, no ita mak sanak sira. Sanak ne'ebé hela iha uvas-huun sei simu bee no kbiit hosi abut hodi fo fuan barak, maibé sanak ne'ebé haketak aan hosi huun sei sai maran no ema sei halibur hodi soe ba ahi laran. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma sadere ba sira-nia kbiit rasik, riku-soin, estatutu, ka superstisaun sira atu buka moris kmanek. Maibé se ita dook hosi Kristu, ita-nia klamar sei maran no ita labele halo buat ida ne'ebé iha valór rohan-laek iha Maromak nia oin.

Na'i Jesus hatudu ho naroman bensaun boot hosi hela iha Nia laran: bainhira ita hela iha Nia no Ninia liafuan hela iha ita, ita bele husu saida de'it tuir Maromak nia hakarak no Aman sei halo ida-ne'e atu hetan glória. Na'i Jesus la bolu tan ita atan, maibé bolu ita Ninia belun sira, tanba Nia fo Ninia moris iha krús tanba ita. La'ós ita mak hili Jesus uluk, maibé Jesus mak hili no haraik knaar ba ita atu baa fo fuan ne'ebé hela nafatin.

Na'i Jesus fo hatene tan razaun hosi Ninia ukun-fuan atu Ninia ksolok bele hela iha ita no ita-nia ksolok sai nakonu, hodi ita hadomi malu hanesan Nia hadomi ita. Ita presiza husik tiha hahalok foti aan, bosok, uza tua demais, no superstisaun sira, hodi hela nafatin iha Kristu nia domin. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste kaer metin ba Na'i Jesus nudar Uvas-Huun Loloos no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin loloos, no laran-moos ba malu, Maromak nia glória no ksolok nakonu sei suli sai bensaun kmanek ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
The Lord Jesus gave His disciples a vivid parable, declaring Himself to be the true vine, His Father the vinedresser, and His followers the branches. A branch bears rich, sweet fruit only when firmly attached to the vine to draw life-giving nourishment; severed from the stem, it withers and is fit only for the fire. Even in Timor-Leste today, young people and believers can fall into relying on personal intelligence, social connections, money, or superstitious habits to secure a prosperous life. Yet apart from Christ, every human effort leaves the soul dry, unable to produce anything of lasting spiritual worth.

Jesus also reveals the abundant blessings of abiding in Him: when we remain in Christ and His words dwell deeply within us, our prayers align with God's will and bring glory to the Father as we bear much fruit. Remarkably, Jesus no longer calls us mere servants, but friends—sharing the Father's heart with us and laying down His own life on the cross for our sake. We did not choose Him first; He sovereignly chose and appointed us to go and bear fruit that will endure forever.

Authentic discipleship is never dry legalistic duty; rather, Jesus commands us to love one another so that His own joy may fill our hearts to overflowing. When a community stays rooted in Christ, pride, deceit, and division give way to honesty, mutual care, and wholehearted unity (laran ida). Let us lay down our self-reliance today, sink our roots deeply into Jesus our True Vine, and bear abundant fruit for His glory.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó sadere ba ó-nia kbiit rasik no dook hosi Kristu, ka ó hela nafatin iha Na'i Jesus nudar Uvas-Huun Loloos hodi simu kbiit no moris nakonu hosi Nia?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you relying on your own human strength apart from Christ, or are you abiding deeply in Jesus the True Vine to receive His life-giving joy and strength?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha hahalok aan-ian, bosok, no divisaun sira, hodi moris nudar belun loloos ba Kristu no lori domin, perdoan, no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you set aside pride, dishonesty, and divisive habits today, living as a true friend of Christ and fostering love, forgiveness, and genuine unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé mai nudar Uvas-Huun Loloos, no bolu ami nudar belun sira hodi fo Ninia moris tanba ami. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha sadere ba aan rasik, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami hela nafatin iha Na'i Jesus nia domin, fo fuan barak ne'ebé hela nafatin, no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who grafted us into Himself as the True Vine, called us His friends, and laid down His life for us on the cross. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off self-reliant pride, dishonesty, and the darkness of superstition. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we may abide continually in Christ's love, bear lasting fruit through obedience to His Word, and bring glory to You in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Mundu nia Odiu no Espíritu Santu nia Sasin: Brani no Kaer Metin ba Fiar iha Perseguisaun nia Leet
title.en: The Hatred of the World and the Witness of the Holy Spirit: Standing Bold and Steadfast in Faith Amid Persecution

theological_insight.tet: Na'i Jesus fó avizu nanis ba eskolante sira katak mundu sei odi sira, tanba Nia hili ona sira sai hosi mundu no atan la boot liu ninia na'i. Mundu nia odiu mai hosi laran-toos ne'ebé la konhese Aman Maromak no la konhese Kristu. Maski lider relijiozu sira sei duni sai no halo terus sarani sira hodi hanoin katak sira serví Maromak, Na'i Jesus promete atu haruka Ajudadór, katak Espíritu Lia-Loos nian, atu fó sasin kona-ba Nia. Ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit, sarani sira sei la monu ba sala iha terus laran, maibé sai sasin brani ba evanjelhu ho ksolok iha Kristu.
theological_insight.en: The Lord Jesus forewarns His disciples that the world will hate them because He has chosen them out of the world, and a servant is never greater than his master. The world's hostility stems from spiritual blindness toward both the Father and the Son, even driving religious authorities to persecute believers under the delusion of serving God. Yet Christ equips His followers so they will not stumble when trials arrive, promising the Helper—the Spirit of truth—to bear witness to Him and empower believers to stand as bold, joyful, counter-cultural witnesses to the gospel.

meditation.tet:
Na'i Jesus hatete ba Ninia disípulu sira ho naroman katak se mundu odi sira, sira tenke hatene katak mundu odi uluk tiha ona Nia, no tanba Nia hili ona sira sai hosi mundu, mundu sei odi sira. Ema ne'ebé moris tuir mundu nia abitu aat sira sei simu gaba hosi mundu, maibé sira ne'ebé Na'i Jesus hili hosi mundu sei enfrenta odiu no perseguisaun. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma hasoru goza, duni sai, ka terus hosi família no komunidade bainhira sira husik tiha hahalok bosok, hemu tua demais, no superstisaun sira atu moris santu. Maibé mundu nia odiu mak sinál katak ita pertense loloos ba Na'i Jesus Kristu.

Na'i Jesus fó avizu nanis atu eskolante sira la monu ba sala bainhira ema hasai sira hosi sinagoga no oho sira hodi hanoin katak sira serví Maromak. Ema sira halo nune'e tanba sira la konhese Aman Maromak no la konhese Kristu. Maibé Na'i Jesus fó kmaan boot hodi promete katak Ajudadór, katak Espíritu Lia-Loos nian, sei mai hosi Aman hodi fó sasin kona-ba Kristu, no disípulu sira mós sei fó sasin iha mundu laran ho brani.

Ita presiza husik tiha ta'uk ba ema nia oin, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira, hodi fó fuan tomak ba Na'i Jesus nia sasin. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste fiar metin ba Kristu iha perseguisaun nia leet, no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin loloos, no laran-moos ba malu, Espíritu Santu nia kbiit sei fakar sai sasin kmanek no naroman ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
In the upper room, the Lord Jesus plainly warned His disciples that the world would hate them just as it hated Him first, because He chose them out of the world. Just as a servant is not greater than his master, those who follow Christ cannot expect applause from a world that rejected the Truth Himself. In Timor-Leste today, young people and believers who turn away from heavy drinking, ancestral worship, dishonesty, and worldly compromises to walk in holiness often face ridicule, rejection, or pressure even from close relatives. Yet the world's hostility is a sacred confirmation that we belong to God.

Jesus also foretold that religious authorities would expel believers from synagogues and even seek their lives while falsely believing they were offering service to God. The Lord shared these warnings ahead of time so that His followers would not stumble or fall away when persecution struck. Crucially, He anchored their courage in a divine promise: the Helper, the Spirit of truth proceeding from the Father, would bear witness to Christ and empower the disciples to testify faithfully.

True discipleship never seeks worldly comfort or compromises truth to avoid rejection; instead, it endures hardship with joy, knowing we share in Christ's sufferings. When believers rely on the indwelling Spirit of truth, fear and hypocrisy give way to honesty, love, and wholehearted unity (laran ida) within our families and youth communities. Let us stand firm without fear today and bear bold witness to Jesus Christ.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó sente ta'uk bainhira ema odi ka ko'alia aat ó tanba fiar ba Kristu, ka ó haksolok tanba fiar katak Espíritu Lia-Loos nian hela iha ó-nia laran hodi fó sasin ba Jesus?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, do you shrink back in fear when facing ridicule or hostility for following Christ, or do you rejoice knowing the Spirit of truth dwells within you to make you a bold witness?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha ta'uk ba ema nia oin, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira, hodi lori sasin moos Kristu nian no uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you cast off the fear of human disapproval, dishonesty, and superstitious compromises today, living with integrity and fostering genuine unity (laran ida) in your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé hili ami sai hosi mundu, no haruka Espíritu Lia-Loos nian atu fó kmaan no kbiit ba ami iha perseguisaun nia leet. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha ta'uk ba mundu nia odiu, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami la monu ba sala, maibé fó sasin ho brani kona-ba Na'i Jesus, no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who chose us out of the world and sent the Spirit of truth to comfort and strengthen us amid hatred and persecution. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off fear of mockery, worldly compromise, dishonesty, and superstition. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we will never stumble in our faith, but boldly testify to the gospel of Christ while living in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Espíritu Santu nia Servisu no Na'i Jesus nia Vitória: Aten-Brani tanba Kristu Manaan Tiha Ona Mundu
title.en: The Ministry of the Holy Spirit and the Victory of the Lord Jesus: Taking Heart Because Christ Has Overcome the World

theological_insight.tet: Molok terus iha krús, Na'i Jesus esplika katak Ninia fila ba Aman lori di'ak ba eskolante sira, tanba Nia sei haruka Ajudadór, katak Espíritu Lia-Loos nian. Espíritu Santu mai atu fó hatene ba mundu kona-ba sala (la fiar ba Kristu), moris loos (Kristu fila ba Aman), no julgamentu (liurai mundu ne'e nian hetan ona tesi-lia), no sei lori sarani sira ba lia-loos hotu hodi fó glória ba Kristu. Maski eskolante sira sei laran-susar hanesan feto ida ne'ebé atu tuur-ahi, sira-nia triste sei nakfilak ba ksolok nakonu liu hosi moris-hias no orasaun iha Jesus nia naran. Ikusmai, Kristu deklara Ninia vitória boot katak iha mundu sira sei hetan terus, maibé sira tenke aten-brani tanba Nia manaan tiha ona mundu.
theological_insight.en: Before His crucifixion, the Lord Jesus explains that His departure to the Father benefits His disciples because it brings the Helper, the Spirit of truth. The Holy Spirit convicts the world regarding sin (unbelief in Christ), righteousness (Christ's return to the Father), and judgment (the ruler of this world stands condemned), while guiding believers into all truth to glorify Jesus. Like a woman in childbirth whose pain turns into joy, the disciples' sorrow will transform into unshakeable gladness through the resurrection and direct prayer in Jesus' name. Finally, Christ anchors our courage in His cosmic victory: though we face tribulation in this world, we take heart because He has already overcome the world.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira Na'i Jesus atu fila ba Aman, Nia hatete ba Ninia eskolante sira ne'ebé laran-triste katak di'ak liu ba sira se Nia baa, tanba se Nia la baa, Ajudadór sei la mai, maibé se Nia baa, Nia sei haruka Espíritu Santu ba sira. Bainhira Espíritu Lia-Loos nian mai, Nia sei fó hatene ho klaru ba mundu kona-ba sala tanba ema la fiar ba Jesus, kona-ba moris loos tanba Jesus baa Aman, no kona-ba julgamentu tanba liurai mundu ne'e nian hetan ona tesi-lia. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma sente ta'uk ba kbiit diabu nian, moris kiak, ka superstisaun sira. Maibé Espíritu Santu hatudu ho naroman katak diabu no nakukun nia kbiit simu tiha ona julgamentu no lakon tiha ona kbiit iha Kristu nia oin.

Na'i Jesus uza ai-knanoik feto ida ne'ebé tuur-ahi hodi fó kmaan ba Ninia disípulu sira: bainhira feto ida atu tuur-ahi, nia laran-susar tanba ninia oras to'o ona, maibé bainhira kosok-oan moris mai ona, nia la hanoin tan ninia terus tanba ksolok boot. Eskolante sira sei tanis no laran-susar iha krús oin, maibé bainhira sira haree fali Na'i Jesus ne'ebé moris-hias, sira-nia ksolok sei sai nakonu no ema ida labele hasai ksolok ne'e hosi sira. Jesus mós fó promesa kmanek katak buat hotu ne'ebé ita husu hosi Aman hodi Ninia naran, Aman sei fó mai ita atu ita-nia ksolok sai nakonu.

Na'i Jesus taka Ninia liafuan iha meza haan kalan ho autoridade boot hodi dehan katak Nia ko'alia buat sira-ne'e atu ita bele iha dame iha Nia; iha mundu ne'e ita sei hetan susar, maibé ita tenke aten-brani tanba Nia manaan tiha ona mundu. Mundu fó terus no susar, maibé Na'i Jesus manaan tiha ona mundu ho Ninia krús no moris-hias. Ita presiza husik tiha laran-susar, ta'uk ba diabu, hahalok bosok, uza tua demais, no superstisaun sira. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste fiar metin ba Na'i Jesus ne'ebé manaan tiha ona mundu, hodi moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Maromak nia dame no vitória sei nabilan ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
On the eve of His crucifixion, the Lord Jesus comforted His sorrowful disciples by explaining that His departure was to their advantage, for only by going to the Father would He send the Helper to them. When the Spirit of truth comes, He convicts the world concerning sin because of unbelief in Christ, concerning righteousness because Jesus goes to the Father, and concerning judgment because the ruler of this world stands condemned. In Timor-Leste today, young people and believers sometimes feel intimidated by spiritual darkness, economic hardship, or lingering fears tied to superstitious traditions. Yet the indwelling Spirit assures us that Satan is already a defeated foe before the cross of Christ.

To encourage their grieving hearts, Jesus compared their coming trial to a woman giving birth: though she experiences anguish when her hour arrives, she forgets the pain in the joy that a child has been born into the world. In the same way, the disciples' grief at the cross would soon turn into an unshakeable joy at the resurrection that no one could ever take away. Moreover, through Christ's finished work, believers receive the extraordinary privilege of praying directly to the Father in Jesus' name so that their joy may be full.

Concluding His upper room discourse, Jesus left a timeless declaration of victory: though we will face tribulation in this world, we can take heart and enjoy His peace because He has already overcome the world. When believers stand on Christ's triumph, fear, deceit, and division lose their grip, giving way to honesty, mutual care, and wholehearted unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. Let us cast off every anxious fear today and walk forward with bold confidence in the Savior who conquered the world.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó husik ó-nia fuan laran-susar tanba susar mundu nian ka ta'uk diabu, ka ó brani ho fuan metin tanba fiar katak Na'i Jesus manaan tiha ona mundu?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, do you let worldly trials or superstitious fears trouble your heart, or do you stand firm with courage knowing that Jesus has already overcome the world?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha laran-susar, hahalok bosok, no divisaun sira, hodi harohan ho aten-brani iha Na'i Jesus nia naran no lori uniaun (laran ida) ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you set aside anxiety, dishonesty, and division today, praying boldly in Jesus' name and fostering genuine unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé haruka Espíritu Lia-Loos nian mai ami, no fó Ninia moris iha krús hodi manaan tiha mundu. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha laran-susar, ta'uk ba diabu, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami hetan dame iha Kristu, harohan hodi Ninia naran kmanek, no moris ho aten-brani iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu nia naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who sent the Spirit of truth to guide us and conquered the world through His cross and resurrection. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off worldly anxiety, fear of evil powers, dishonesty, and superstition. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we may experience Christ's peace, pray boldly in His name, and live with courage in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.

title.tet: Na'i Jesus nia Orasaun Kmanek ba Disípulu Sira no Igreja Tomak: Sai Ida De'it iha Maromak nia Domin no Santu iha Lia-Loos
title.en: The Lord Jesus' High Priestly Prayer for His Disciples and the Church: Becoming One in God's Love and Sanctified in Truth

theological_insight.tet: Molok terus iha krús, Na'i Jesus foti matan ba lalehan hodi halo Orasaun Kmanek nudar Amlulik Boot, hodi fó sai katak moris rohan-laek mak konhese Aman Maromak loos mesak de'it no Jesus Kristu ne'ebé Nia haruka mai. Nia halo orasaun la'ós de'it ba eskolante sira, maibé mós ba ema hotu ne'ebé sei fiar liu hosi sira-nia liafuan, atu Aman proteje sira hosi aat-na'in iha mundu laran no halo sira santu liu hosi Maromak nia Liafuan ne'ebé nudar Lia-Loos. Ksolok nakonu iha moris sarani mai hosi haree Kristu nia glória no moris iha uniaun kompletu hanesan Aman no Oan mak ida de'it, atu mundu bele fiar katak Aman haruka Kristu mai.
theological_insight.en: Just before His crucifixion, the Lord Jesus lifts His eyes to heaven in His majestic High Priestly Prayer, defining eternal life as knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ whom He has sent. Praying not only for His immediate disciples but for every future generation of believers, Christ asks the Father to protect His people from the evil one within the world and sanctify them completely through the truth of God's Word. Fullness of joy is found in beholding Christ's eternal glory and reflecting the unity of the Father and the Son, so that a divided world may believe that the Father sent the Son.

meditation.tet:
Bainhira Na'i Jesus atu baa terus iha krús, Nia foti matan ba lalehan no halo Orasaun Kmanek boot liu ba Ninia disípulu sira no fiar-na'in hotu. Na'i Jesus fo sai lia-loos kmanek katak moris rohan-laek mak konhese Aman, Maromak loos mesak de'it, no Jesus Kristu, ne'ebé Aman haruka mai. Moris rohan-laek la'ós de'it buat ne'ebé ita simu iha lalehan iha aban-bairua, maibé konhese loloos Aman Maromak no Na'i Jesus iha fuan laran no moris hamutuk ho Nia loron-loron.

Na'i Jesus halo orasaun ho laran-luak ba Ninia disípulu sira no ba fiar-na'in hotu ne'ebé sei mosu mai, atu Aman Santu tau matan ba sira iha Ninia naran hodi sira bele sai ida de'it hanesan Aman no Oan mak ida de'it. Maski ita hela iha mundu laran, ita la'ós hosi mundu ne'e, no ita presiza Maromak nia proteje hosi aat-na'in. Na'i Jesus husu ba Aman atu halo ita santu iha lia-loos, tanba Maromak nia Liafuan mak lia-loos. Iha Timor-Leste, foin-sa'e no sarani sira dalaruma hasoru divizaun, hahalok bosok, uza tua demais, ka superstisaun sira. Maibé bainhira ita husik tiha buat aat sira-ne'e no simu Maromak nia Liafuan ne'ebé santu, ita-nia moris muda ba laran-moos no uniaun kompletu (laran ida).

Na'i Jesus halo orasaun atu fiar-na'in hotu bele sai ida de'it to'o kompletu, atu mundu bele hatene katak Aman Maromak haruka Jesus mai no hadomi sira hanesan Nia hadomi Jesus. Domin ne'ebé Aman fó ba Kristu hela mós iha ita-nia fuan laran. Ita presiza husik tiha divizaun, foti aan, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Bainhira foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin loloos, no laran-moos iha família no komunidade tomak, Maromak nia glória no domin sei nabilan ba nasaun tomak.
meditation.en:
On the threshold of the cross, the Lord Jesus lifted His eyes to heaven and offered His great High Priestly Prayer for His disciples and all future believers. Defining eternal life with crystal clarity, Jesus declared that eternal life is to know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent. Eternal life is not merely a future reward in heaven; it is an intimate, living knowledge and fellowship with the Father and the Son that begins right now.

Jesus prayed earnestly that the Holy Father would keep His people in His name and guard them from the evil one while they remain in the world, though not of the world. He also pleaded that the Father sanctify them in truth, declaring that God's Word is truth. In Timor-Leste today, young people and believers often face division, dishonesty, heavy drinking, or lingering superstitious habits. Yet as we cast off falsehood and let God's Word cleanse and sanctify us, our lives are transformed into honesty, holiness, and wholehearted unity (laran ida).

Finally, Jesus prayed that all believers may be made completely one, just as the Father and the Son are one, so that the world may know that the Father sent Christ and loves His people just as He loves the Son. True unity is not shallow compromise, but a deep bond rooted in the truth of the gospel and the Father's love dwelling within us. Let us lay aside division, pride, and deceit today, living in honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and youth communities for God's glory.

reflection_questions.tet: Iha ó-nia moris loron-loron nian, ó buka duni konhese Aman Maromak no Na'i Jesus Kristu ho laran-moos nudar moris rohan-laek, ka ó sei moris iha foti aan no hahalok sala mundu nian?
reflection_questions.en: In your daily life, are you earnestly seeking to know the only true God and Jesus Christ as your eternal life, or are you living in pride and worldly compromise?

reflection_questions.tet: Oinsá mak ó bele husik tiha divizaun, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira, hodi halo tuir Na'i Jesus nia orasaun hodi lori uniaun kompletu (laran ida), santu iha lia-loos, no domin ba ó-nia família no foin-sa'e sira iha loron ohin?
reflection_questions.en: How will you set aside division, dishonesty, and superstition today, answering Jesus' prayer by living sanctified in the truth and fostering complete unity (laran ida) within your family and youth community?

prayer.tet: Aman Maromak ne'ebé iha lalehan, ami fo agradese boot ba Na'i Jesus Kristu ne'ebé halo Orasaun Kmanek ba ami no fo Ninia moris iha krús atu lori ami ba moris rohan-laek. Tulun foin-sa'e no sarani sira iha Timor-Leste atu husik tiha divizaun, hahalok bosok, no superstisaun sira. Hakonu ami ho Espíritu Santu nia kbiit atu ami konhese Ita-Boot no Na'i Jesus, sai santu iha Ita-nia Liafuan ne'ebé nudar Lia-Loos, no moris iha uniaun kompletu (laran ida), domin, no laran-moos iha ami-nia família no komunidade tomak. Iha Na'i Jesus Kristu naran ami halo orasaun. Amén.
prayer.en: Heavenly Father, we give You great thanks for the Lord Jesus Christ, who interceded for us in His High Priestly Prayer and gave His life on the cross to bring us into eternal life. Help the youth and believers in Timor-Leste to cast off division, dishonesty, and superstition. Fill us with the power of the Holy Spirit so that we may know You and Jesus Christ, be sanctified in Your Word of truth, and reflect Your glory through honesty, love, and true unity (laran ida) within our families and communities. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ we pray. Amen.
